items.title_en: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
items.abstract_en: Deeper neural networks are more difficult to train. We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper than those used previously. We explicitly reformulate the layers as learning residual functions with reference to the layer inputs, instead of learning unreferenced functions. We provide comprehensive empirical evidence showing that these residual networks are easier to optimize, and can gain accuracy from considerably increased depth. On the ImageNet dataset we evaluate residual nets with a depth of up to 152 layers---8x deeper than VGG nets but still having lower complexity. An ensemble of these residual nets achieves 3.57% error on the ImageNet test set. This result won the 1st place on the ILSVRC 2015 classification task. We also present analysis on CIFAR-10 with 100 and 1000 layers. The depth of representations is of central importance for many visual recognition tasks. Solely due to our extremely deep representations, we obtain a 28% relative improvement on the COCO object detection dataset. Deep residual nets are foundations of our submissions to ILSVRC & COCO 2015 competitions, where we also won the 1st places on the tasks of ImageNet detection, ImageNet localization, COCO detection, and COCO segmentation.

items.title_zh: 用于图像识别的深度残差学习
items.abstract_zh: 更深的神经网络更难训练。本文提出一种残差学习框架，用以简化比以往网络明显更深的网络的训练。我们将网络层显式地重新表述为学习相对于层输入的残差函数，而非学习无参照的函数。充分的实证表明，残差网络更易优化，并能随深度大幅增加而提升精度。在 ImageNet 上，我们评估了深达 152 层的残差网络——比 VGG 深 8 倍但复杂度更低。多个残差网络的集成在 ImageNet 测试集上取得 3.57% 的错误率，获得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名。我们还对 100 层和 1000 层的 CIFAR-10 网络进行了分析。表示深度对许多视觉识别任务至关重要：仅凭极深的表示，我们在 COCO 目标检测数据集上取得 28% 的相对提升。深度残差网络是我们参加 ILSVRC 与 COCO 2015 竞赛的基础，并同时获得 ImageNet 检测、定位和 COCO 检测、分割第一名。
items.highlight_zh: 残差连接让网络轻松训练到152层，并夺得多项竞赛冠军
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究问题：神经网络理论上是层数越深表达能力越强，但实际中网络加深后反而更难训练，误差不降反升。作者认为这不是过拟合，而是优化困难。
2) 方法：提出“残差学习”。与其让若干层直接学目标映射 H(x)，不如让它们学残差 F(x)=H(x)-x，再通过一条跨层的“捷径连接”把输入 x 直接加到输出上。这样若最优结果接近恒等映射，网络只需把残差压到接近零，比从头拟合恒等映射容易得多。这种结构不增加参数，也不明显增加计算量。
3) 结果：在 ImageNet 上训练了 18 到 152 层不等的残差网络，发现网络越深精度越高，且比同深度的普通网络更易优化。152 层模型虽比 VGG 深 8 倍，计算复杂度却更低；多模型集成在测试集上错误率仅 3.57%，拿下 ILSVRC 2015 分类冠军。CIFAR-10 上甚至试到 1000 层。此外，仅把骨干换成极深残差网络，COCO 目标检测就取得 28% 的相对提升。
4) 意义：这项工作证明了“深度”本身对视觉识别至关重要，并给出了让深度真正可训练的关键工程与思想——残差连接。它后来成为几乎所有现代深度网络（包括后续的 Transformer 等）的基础构件，是深度学习发展史上影响最广的论文之一。

items.title_en: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
items.abstract_en: Abstract Proteins are essential to life, and understanding their structure can facilitate a mechanistic understanding of their function. Through an enormous experimental effort 1–4 , the structures of around 100,000 unique proteins have been determined 5 , but this represents a small fraction of the billions of known protein sequences 6,7 . Structural coverage is bottlenecked by the months to years of painstaking effort required to determine a single protein structure. Accurate computational approaches are needed to address this gap and to enable large-scale structural bioinformatics. Predicting the three-dimensional structure that a protein will adopt based solely on its amino acid sequence—the structure prediction component of the ‘protein folding problem’ 8 —has been an important open research problem for more than 50 years 9 . Despite recent progress 10–14 , existing methods fall far short of atomic accuracy, especially when no homologous structure is available. Here we provide the first computational method that can regularly predict protein structures with atomic accuracy even in cases in which no similar structure is known. We validated an entirely redesigned version of our neural network-based model, AlphaFold, in the challenging 14th Critical Assessment of protein Structure Prediction (CASP14) 15 , demonstrating accuracy competitive with experimental structures in a majority of cases and greatly outperforming other methods. Underpinning the latest version of AlphaFold is a novel machine learning approach that incorporates physical and biological knowledge about protein structure, leveraging multi-sequence alignments, into the design of the deep learning algorithm.

items.title_zh: 使用 AlphaFold 进行高精度蛋白质结构预测
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质对生命至关重要，理解其结构有助于从机制上理解其功能。经过大量实验努力，迄今已测定约 10 万种不同蛋白质的结构，但这只是已知数十亿条蛋白质序列中的一小部分。结构覆盖受限于测定单个蛋白质结构所需的数月到数年艰苦工作。因此需要准确的计算方法以填补这一空白并支撑大规模结构生物信息学。仅根据氨基酸序列预测蛋白质将采取的三维结构——即“蛋白质折叠问题”中的结构预测部分——五十多年来一直是重要的开放研究难题。尽管近年有进展，现有方法仍远未达到原子级精度，在没有同源结构时尤其如此。本文给出首个即使在无相似结构可参考时也能常规预测出原子级精度结构的方法。我们在具挑战性的第 14 届蛋白质结构预测关键评估（CASP14）中验证了完全重新设计的神经网络模型 AlphaFold，在多数情况下精度可与实验结构媲美，并大幅超越其他方法。最新版 AlphaFold 的核心是一种新颖的机器学习方法，它将关于蛋白质结构的物理与生物学知识、对多序列比对（MSA）的利用，融入到深度学习算法的设计中。
items.highlight_zh: AlphaFold在CASP14上实现接近实验水平的原子级结构预测
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究问题：蛋白质由氨基酸序列折叠成三维结构，结构决定功能。实验测定结构极其耗时（单个蛋白可能需数月到数年），而已测结构仅约 10 万种，远少于已知的数十亿条序列，形成巨大“结构鸿沟”。仅凭氨基酸序列预测结构的“蛋白质折叠问题”已悬而未决五十余年；以往计算方法精度不足，尤其当数据库中没有相似（同源）结构可借鉴时更是束手无策。
2) 方法：作者彻底重新设计了神经网络模型 AlphaFold，关键是把关于蛋白质结构的物理与生物学先验知识、特别是多序列比对（MSA）信息，融入深度学习架构设计中，而不是纯靠数据硬学。模型直接输出每个原子位置的预测及其置信度。
3) 结果：在 CASP14 这一国际盲测评估中，AlphaFold 在大多数目标上达到与实验测定结构相当的精度，远超其他参赛方法，被评估方视为该领域数十年来的一大突破。
4) 意义：它首次证明了纯计算方法可以常规地逼近原子级精度，使大规模、高通量的结构生物信息学成为可能，对药物设计、酶工程和基础生物学研究都有深远影响；同时展示了把领域科学知识嵌入深度学习架构的巨大价值。

items.title_en: All-Optical Machine Learning Using Diffractive Deep Neural Networks
items.abstract_en: We introduce an all-optical Diffractive Deep Neural Network (D2NN) architecture that can learn to implement various functions after deep learning-based design of passive diffractive layers that work collectively. We experimentally demonstrated the success of this framework by creating 3D-printed D2NNs that learned to implement handwritten digit classification and the function of an imaging lens at terahertz spectrum. With the existing plethora of 3D-printing and other lithographic fabrication methods as well as spatial-light-modulators, this all-optical deep learning framework can perform, at the speed of light, various complex functions that computer-based neural networks can implement, and will find applications in all-optical image analysis, feature detection and object classification, also enabling new camera designs and optical components that can learn to perform unique tasks using D2NNs.

items.title_zh: 使用衍射深度神经网络的全光学机器学习
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种全光学衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）架构：在基于深度学习的设计下，一组无源衍射层协同工作，从而学会实现各种功能。我们通过制作 3D 打印的 D2NN，在太赫兹波段上实验演示了该框架的成功——它们学会了实现手写数字分类以及成像透镜的功能。借助现有丰富的 3D 打印与其他光刻制造方法以及空间光调制器，这一全光学深度学习框架能以光速执行计算机神经网络可实现的多种复杂功能，并将应用于全光学图像分析、特征检测与物体分类，同时催生能够利用 D2NN 学习执行独特任务的新型相机设计与光学元件。
items.highlight_zh: 3D打印的无源衍射层堆叠，以光速完成分类与成像
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究问题：传统神经网络靠电子计算机运行，能耗和速度受限于芯片。能否让“计算”直接在光传播过程中完成？作者尝试用纯光学元件搭建神经网络，让光穿过器件时就完成推理，无需任何光电转换或电子计算。
2) 方法：提出衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）。它由多层无源衍射面（可理解为刻有特定相位图案的薄片）堆叠而成，每层对通过的光波做相位调制，光在层间自由传播相当于层间连接，最终在输出面形成光强分布表示分类结果。各层的相位图案不是手工设计，而是用深度学习（误差反向传播）在计算机上训练出来的，之后物理制造即可。
3) 结果：作者用 3D 打印制作了工作在太赫兹波段的 D2NN，实验证明它能完成手写数字分类，还能充当成像透镜，即同一套框架可学习实现不同光学功能。
4) 意义：由于器件无源、无需供电计算，信息以光速并行传播，有望带来极低延迟、低能耗的视觉前端——如能自行完成图像分析、特征检测和目标分类的新型相机与光学元件。这也开创了“用制造出来的物理结构做机器学习”的新范式。

items.title_en: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
items.abstract_en: Tree boosting is a highly effective and widely used machine learning method. In this paper, we describe a scalable end-to-end tree boosting system called XGBoost, which is used widely by data scientists to achieve state-of-the-art results on many machine learning challenges. We propose a novel sparsity-aware algorithm for sparse data and weighted quantile sketch for approximate tree learning. More importantly, we provide insights on cache access patterns, data compression and sharding to build a scalable tree boosting system. By combining these insights, XGBoost scales beyond billions of examples using far fewer resources than existing systems.

items.title_zh: XGBoost：一个可扩展的树提升系统
items.abstract_zh: 树提升是一种极为有效且广泛使用的机器学习方法。本文描述一个可扩展的端到端树提升系统 XGBoost，它被数据科学家广泛用于在许多机器学习竞赛中取得最先进的结果。我们针对稀疏数据提出一种新颖的稀疏感知算法，并提出用于近似树学习的加权分位数草图。更重要的是，我们深入剖析了缓存访问模式、数据压缩与分片，以构建可扩展的树提升系统。综合这些洞见，XGBoost 仅用远少于现有系统的资源就能扩展到数十亿级样本。
items.highlight_zh: 稀疏感知与缓存优化让树提升扩展到数十亿样本
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究问题：梯度提升树（GBDT）精度高、用途广，但当数据规模达到上亿甚至数十亿样本、特征高度稀疏时，传统实现训练慢、内存吃不消。论文要打造一个既快又省资源、能端到端使用的树提升系统。
2) 方法：在算法层面，提出“稀疏感知”算法，让系统能自动识别稀疏特征中的缺失值并为其学出默认分支方向，从而高效处理稀疏数据；提出“加权分位数草图”，用近似方式快速找到树分裂的候选切分点，兼顾速度与精度。在工程层面，系统分析了缓存访问模式、数据压缩与数据分片策略，例如按特征列预排序并分块存储、支持多线程并行与核外计算，从而充分利用硬件。
3) 结果：把这些设计组合起来，XGBoost 用远少于已有系统的资源就能扩展到数十亿级样本，训练速度和内存效率显著提升，并成为众多机器学习竞赛的常用夺冠工具。
4) 意义：它把“统计算法设计”和“底层系统优化”结合起来，说明机器学习模型的实用性不仅取决于数学，也取决于工程实现。XGBoost 因此成为表格数据建模最主流的工具之一，被数据科学界广泛采用。

items.title_en: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
items.abstract_en: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. Unlike recent language representation models, BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers. As a result, the pre-trained BERT model can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models for a wide range of tasks, such as question answering and language inference, without substantial task-specific architecture modifications. BERT is conceptually simple and empirically powerful. It obtains new state-of-the-art results on eleven natural language processing tasks, including pushing the GLUE score to 80.5% (7.7% point absolute improvement), MultiNLI accuracy to 86.7% (4.6% absolute improvement), SQuAD v1.1 question answering Test F1 to 93.2 (1.5 point absolute improvement) and SQuAD v2.0 Test F1 to 83.1 (5.1 point absolute improvement).

items.title_zh: BERT：用于语言理解的深度双向 Transformer 预训练
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出新的语言表示模型 BERT，即基于 Transformer 的双向编码器表示。与近期模型不同，BERT 在所有层中同时结合左右上下文，从无标注文本中预训练深度双向表示。因此预训练好的 BERT 只需额外加一个输出层做微调，就能在问答、自然语言推断等大量任务上取得当前最佳效果，而无需大幅改动任务专属结构。BERT 概念简单却实证有力，在 11 项自然语言处理任务上刷新纪录：GLUE 提升至 80.5%（绝对提升 7.7 个百分点），MultiNLI 准确率 86.7%（提升 4.6），SQuAD v1.1 测试 F1 达 93.2（提升 1.5），SQuAD v2.0 测试 F1 达 83.1（提升 5.1）。
items.highlight_zh: 双向预训练加一层微调，刷新 11 项 NLP 任务纪录
items.digest_zh:
① 问题：在 BERT 之前，语言模型多是单向的（从左到右或从右到左），每个词只能看到一侧上下文，难以同时理解前后文；而且每换一个新任务往往要重新设计网络结构。
② 方法：BERT 用 Transformer 编码器做「完形填空」式的掩码语言建模，并加入「下一句预测」任务，在所有层同时利用左右两侧上下文，从海量无标注文本中预训练深层双向表示。
③ 结果：预训练好的 BERT 只需在顶层加一个小输出层、用少量标注数据微调，就能迁移到问答、自然语言推断等任务；在 11 项 NLP 基准上刷新纪录，GLUE 80.5%（+7.7）、MultiNLI 86.7%（+4.6）、SQuAD v1.1 F1 93.2、SQuAD v2.0 F1 83.1。
④ 意义：它确立了「大规模预训练 + 轻量微调」的范式，证明通用语言表示可跨任务复用，成为此后 NLP 与大模型研究的基础模板。

items.title_en: ORB-SLAM3: An Accurate Open-Source Library for Visual, Visual-Inertial and Multi-Map SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents ORB-SLAM3, the first system able to perform visual, visual-inertial and multi-map SLAM with monocular, stereo and RGB-D cameras, using pin-hole and fisheye lens models. The first main novelty is a feature-based tightly-integrated visual-inertial SLAM system that fully relies on Maximum-a-Posteriori (MAP) estimation, even during the IMU initialization phase. The result is a system that operates robustly in real-time, in small and large, indoor and outdoor environments, and is 2 to 5 times more accurate than previous approaches. The second main novelty is a multiple map system that relies on a new place recognition method with improved recall. Thanks to it, ORB-SLAM3 is able to survive to long periods of poor visual information: when it gets lost, it starts a new map that will be seamlessly merged with previous maps when revisiting mapped areas. Compared with visual odometry systems that only use information from the last few seconds, ORB-SLAM3 is the first system able to reuse in all the algorithm stages all previous information. This allows to include in bundle adjustment co-visible keyframes, that provide high parallax observations boosting accuracy, even if they are widely separated in time or if they come from a previous mapping session. Our experiments show that, in all sensor configurations, ORB-SLAM3 is as robust as the best systems available in the literature, and significantly more accurate. Notably, our stereo-inertial SLAM achieves an average accuracy of 3.6 cm on the EuRoC drone and 9 mm under quick hand-held motions in the room of TUM-VI dataset, a setting representative of AR/VR scenarios. For the benefit of the community we make public the source code.

items.title_zh: ORB-SLAM3：面向视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的精确开源库
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 ORB-SLAM3，首个用单目、双目与 RGB-D 相机（支持针孔与鱼眼镜头模型）统一实现视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的系统。其一，是完全依赖最大后验（MAP）估计的特征法紧耦合视觉惯性 SLAM，连 IMU 初始化阶段也如此，可在室内外大小场景实时鲁棒运行，精度比以往方法高 2 至 5 倍；其二，是基于高召回率地点识别的多地图系统，跟丢时新建地图，重访旧区域时无缝合并。它能在所有算法阶段复用全部历史信息，使在时间上相隔很远甚至来自先前建图会话的共视关键帧参与光束法平差，提供高视差观测以提升精度。实验显示各传感器配置下其鲁棒性与最佳系统相当且精度显著更高：双目惯性在 EuRoC 无人机上平均精度 3.6 cm，TUM-VI 快速手持场景为 9 mm。源码已公开。
items.highlight_zh: 全 MAP 估计加多地图合并，视觉惯性精度提升 2–5 倍
items.digest_zh:
① 问题：机器人同时定位与建图（SLAM）时，若摄像头短时间被遮挡或视野贫乏（快速转向、对着白墙），传统系统往往直接失效、轨迹丢失且无法恢复。
② 方法：ORB-SLAM3 用特征点法把视觉观测与 IMU 读数紧耦合，统一在最大后验（MAP）估计框架下求解，连 IMU 初始化也纳入优化；同时引入高召回率的地点识别，使系统能维护多张地图，回到旧区域时把它们对齐合并。
③ 结果：支持单目/双目/RGB-D 与针孔/鱼眼镜头组合，精度比此前方法高 2 至 5 倍；双目惯性在 EuRoC 无人机数据上平均误差 3.6 cm，TUM-VI 快速手持场景下 9 mm。
④ 意义：它把历史信息在所有环节复用（包括时间相隔很远、甚至来自上一次建图会话的关键帧），让系统在长时间弱视觉条件下依然存活，且完全开源，成为视觉 SLAM 的重要基线。

items.title_en: Jeveration: System One Models Now Generate
items.title_zh: Jeveration：System One 模型如今也能生成图像
items.abstract_en: System One models such as Jev return decisions through fast, parallel prediction. In this paper, we introduce Jeveration, showing that the same decision paradigm can also generate high-quality images in a single forward pass. Jeveration builds on a frozen vision-language model, repurposing its visual-semantic knowledge for holistic image generation. The key challenge is to maintain global consistency. A single prompt admits many valid images, yet parallel predictions must converge on a coherent whole. We therefore condition all positions on a shared random state to coordinate parallel predictions, so that each draw yields a different but coherent image. Since the model tends to ignore this state under direct image supervision, we first learn a distribution over discrete image codes to guide single-pass generation. Beyond text-to-image generation, we further unify image-to-image generation and dense prediction within the same architecture, so that one checkpoint supports all three tasks, each in one forward pass. Experiments show that Jeveration generates a 512x512 image in 78 ms, up to 122x faster than existing unified models, while maintaining competitive image quality and dense prediction performance.
items.abstract_zh: System One 类模型（如 Jev）通过快速并行预测给出决策。本文提出 Jeveration，表明同一决策范式也能在单次前向传播中生成高质量图像。Jeveration 基于冻结的视觉-语言模型，复用其视觉-语义知识进行整体图像生成。关键挑战是保持全局一致性：单个提示对应许多有效图像，而并行预测必须收敛为一个协调的整体。因此作者让所有位置都以一个共享随机状态为条件来协调并行预测，使每次采样得到不同但连贯的图像。由于直接图像监督下模型易忽略该状态，作者先学习离散图像码上的分布来引导单次生成。除文生图外，同一架构还统一了图像到图像生成与稠密预测，一个检查点即可一次前向完成三件事。实验显示 Jeveration 用 78 ms 生成 512×512 图像，比现有统一模型快至多 122 倍，同时保持有竞争力的图像质量与稠密预测性能。
items.highlight_zh: 单次前向 78 ms 生成 512×512 图像，快至多 122 倍
items.digest_zh:
① 问题：System One 类模型（如 Jev）用一次并行预测就给出答案，速度极快；但这类「一次前向」范式能否也用于生成整张图像？难点在于并行预测之间必须彼此协调，否则画面会自相矛盾、整体不连贯。
② 方法：Jeveration 冻结一个视觉-语言模型，复用其视觉-语义知识直接生成图像。为保持全局一致，它让所有位置都以一个共享随机状态为条件——相当于给整幅画一个统一「种子」，不同种子给出不同但内部协调的图像。由于直接用图像监督时模型容易忽略该状态，作者先学习离散图像码上的分布来引导单次生成。
③ 结果：同一架构、同一检查点还统一了文生图、图生图与稠密预测三类任务，各只需一次前向；生成 512×512 图像仅需 78 ms，比现有统一模型快至多 122 倍，图像质量与稠密预测性能仍有竞争力。
④ 意义：它表明「快思考」式的并行决策模型同样能胜任生成任务，为把统一模型做得更快提供了新思路。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Timing the Target: Exploring the Circadian Transcriptome of Biologic Therapies in Asthma.
items.title_zh: 为靶点定时：哮喘生物制剂治疗的昼夜节律转录组探索
items.abstract_en: Background: Many of the immune pathways involved in asthma or in asthma treatment show circadian or diurnal variation. Understanding this variation can aid in biomarker discovery and/or therapy optimization. Objective: To evaluate if receptors, cytokines, and their pathways (n=46) targeted by currently approved biologics show significant diurnal rhythmicity and to identify their peak expression time. Methods: We used longitudinal bulk RNA sequencing datasets (discovery/replication cohorts: GSE113883 and GSE223613) and one microarray file (GSE39445) for cross-platform replication/validation. First, we used 16 canonical clock genes (including CLOCK, BMAL1, REV-ERB-beta) as positive controls to explore rhythmicity in each cohort. Thereafter, we evaluated if any targets of currently approved biologics or their corresponding receptors showed significant diurnal variation. For significant genes (Benjamini-Hochberg FDR<0.05), we estimated the baseline average, phase, peak-time of expression across the 24-hour day using clock time and quantified the cross-cohort consistency in the peak time of expression across the cohorts. Results: These cohorts included 453 longitudinal samples collected every two to four hours over a 24-28h cycle. Twelve (75%) of 16 evaluable clock genes showed significant rhythmicity. Only 34 of 46 (74%) asthma-related genes were evaluable across two or more cohorts. Of these 34 genes, 23 (68%) showed significant variation. Across all cohorts, the most preserved rhythmically expressed targets included many pathways or targets of monoclonal antibodies that are currently approved or in development: GATA3 and STAT6, master regulators of type 2 inflammation and IL4/IL13 signaling; chemokines, including the neutrophil chemoattractant, CXCL8; IL-5RA, benralizumab's target; FcRE1, suppressed by omalizumab; and IL1RL1(ST2) in clinical trials. Conclusion: Many therapeutic targets in asthma show significant diurnal rhythmicity. Future studies on how dosing time affects their therapeutic effectiveness while minimizing side effects are needed.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：哮喘及其治疗涉及的许多免疫通路存在昼夜节律变化，理解这些变化有助于生物标志物发现与治疗优化。目的：评估目前已获批生物制剂所靶向的受体、细胞因子及其通路（n=46）是否具有显著昼夜节律性，并确定其表达峰值时间。方法：使用纵向批量 RNA 测序数据集（发现/重复队列 GSE113883、GSE223613）及一个微阵列文件（GSE39445）进行跨平台重复与验证；先以 16 个经典时钟基因（含 CLOCK、BMAL1、REV-ERB-beta）作阳性对照，再评估各靶点及其受体是否有显著日变化，对显著基因（Benjamini-Hochberg FDR<0.05）估计 24 小时内的基线均值、相位与表达峰值时间，并量化跨队列一致性。结果：各队列共 453 份纵向样本，每 2 至 4 小时采集一次，覆盖 24–28 小时；16 个可评估时钟基因中 12 个（75%）显著节律；46 个哮喘相关基因中 34 个可在两个及以上队列评估，其中 23 个（68%）显著变异。跨队列最稳定的节律性靶点包括 GATA3 与 STAT6（2 型炎症及 IL4/IL13 信号主调控因子）、趋化因子如 CXCL8，以及 IL-5RA、benralizumab 等单抗通路。
items.highlight_zh: 68% 的哮喘生物制剂靶点存在显著昼夜表达节律
items.digest_zh:
① 问题：人体免疫系统按生物钟运转，哮喘症状与许多免疫通路都有昼夜起伏。已获批的生物制剂（多为单抗）各自瞄准特定受体或细胞因子，但这些靶点在一天中是否也有表达节律、何时最高，此前缺少系统梳理。
② 方法：作者用两个纵向批量 RNA 测序队列（GSE113883、GSE223613）和一个微阵列数据集（GSE39445）做发现、重复与跨平台验证。样本每 2 至 4 小时采集一次，共 453 份。先用 16 个经典时钟基因作阳性对照，检验节律检测是否可靠；再逐一评估 46 个生物制剂靶点及其受体是否有显著日变化（FDR<0.05），并估计各自峰值表达时间与跨队列一致性。
③ 结果：16 个时钟基因中 12 个（75%）显示显著节律，说明方法可行；46 个哮喘相关基因中 34 个可在至少两个队列评估，其中 23 个（68%）有显著变异。跨队列最稳定的节律靶点包括 2 型炎症主调控因子 GATA3、STAT6，趋化因子 CXCL8，以及 IL-5RA（benralizumab 靶点）等。
④ 意义：这提示部分生物制剂靶点在一天中存在表达高峰，给药时间点可能影响疗效，为选择用药时机、寻找节律相关生物标志物提供了线索，但仍需临床研究验证。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Orientation-Tunable Interfacial Thermal Conductance in Lateral MoSe2/MoS2 Heterostructures: A Deep Potential Molecular Dynamics Study
items.title_zh: 取向可调的横向 MoSe2/MoS2 异质结构界面热导：深度势分子动力学研究
items.abstract_en: Managing heat flow across interfaces in lateral 2D transition-metal dichalcogenide (TMD) heterostructures is a key challenge for next-generation nanoelectronic and optoelectronic devices. To tackle this, we trained a deep learning interatomic potential (DLP) using DeePMD-kit on density functional theory (DFT) data, then paired it with non-equilibrium molecular dynamics (NEMD) simulations to study interfacial thermal conductance (ITC) in lateral MoSe$_2$/MoS$_2$ heterostructures, considering both armchair and zigzag interface orientations. The potential we trained closely matches DFT energies, forces, and phonon dispersion relations, which confirms its reliability for thermal transport simulations. Examining cell lengths from 10 to 40 nm and extrapolating to infinite length, the armchair interface shows a higher ITC (473 MW/m$^2$K) than the zigzag interface (387 MW/m$^2$K), and the armchair interface remains higher at every length considered. Both increase further as temperature rises. At 300 K, the vibrational density of states shows greater phonon spectral overlap at the armchair interface than at the zigzag interface. Together, these results offer a solid machine-learning framework for studying heat transport in lateral TMD heterostructures, and identify interface orientation as an effective means of controlling heat dissipation at these junctions.
items.abstract_zh: 横向二维过渡金属硫族化合物（TMD）异质结构的界面热流管理是下一代纳米电子与光电器件的关键挑战。作者基于密度泛函理论（DFT）数据，用 DeePMD-kit 训练深度学习原子间势（DLP），结合非平衡分子动力学（NEMD）研究横向 MoSe2/MoS2 异质结构在扶手椅与锯齿界面取向下的界面热导（ITC）。势函数与 DFT 能量、力和声子色散吻合良好。将长度从 10 nm 外推至无限长，扶手椅界面 ITC（473 MW/m2K）高于锯齿界面（387 MW/m2K），且在各长度下均更高；温度升高时两者均增大。300 K 下扶手椅界面的声子谱重叠更大。该工作提供了机器学习框架，并表明界面取向可调控散热。
items.highlight_zh: 扶手椅界面热导高于锯齿界面，界面取向可调控散热
items.digest_zh: 这篇论文关注一个很具体的工程问题：当二维材料横向拼接成异质结构时，热量穿过接口会遇到多大阻力，以及这种阻力能否通过改变接口的原子排列方向来调节。研究对象是横向 MoSe2/MoS2 异质结构，接口有两种常见取向：扶手椅型和锯齿型。作者没有直接用经验势，而是先用 DFT 数据训练了一个深度学习原子间势，并验证它能复现能量、力和声子色散；然后把它放进非平衡分子动力学模拟中，测量界面热导。为了排除有限尺寸影响，他们计算了 10 到 40 nm 不同长度并外推到无限长。结果显示扶手椅界面的界面热导约 473 MW/m2K，高于锯齿界面的 387 MW/m2K，而且在所有模拟长度上都更高；温度升高时两者都上升。300 K 下的声子态密度分析表明，扶手椅界面的声子谱重叠更强，这为热导差异提供了微观解释。意义在于：一方面给出了可用于横向 TMD 异质结构热输运的机器学习模拟框架；另一方面说明界面取向是一个可设计的调控旋钮，对未来纳米器件散热和热管理有直接参考价值。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: Horizontal Flow Matching for Single-Cell Spatiotemporal Dynamics
items.title_zh: 面向单细胞时空动力学的水平流匹配
items.abstract_en: Learning the spatiotemporal dynamics of cells from spatial transcriptomics requires connecting snapshots of different cells acquired in different coordinate frames. A rotation or translation of a section can appear as cell movement and distort the inferred correspondence. We introduce horizontal flow matching, which learns changes in tissue organization, molecular state, and cell abundance up to shared rigid motion. The dynamics follow a continuity--reaction equation whose action assigns no cost to shared rigid motion, and the resulting horizontal projector removes this component from spatial prediction errors during learning and from predicted velocities during generation. An equivalent endpoint problem jointly estimates correspondence and relative pose in Wasserstein--Fisher--Rao geometry and yields analytic paths whose velocity and growth serve as regression targets. Regressing these targets recovers the horizontal dynamics under ideal population conditions. Our model, HORIZON, uses an equivariant transformer to predict velocity and growth from the current tissue, so that a tissue can be generated continuously from a single initial snapshot. On a simulated tissue observed in perturbed coordinate frames, alignment improves reconstruction and projection reduces rigid drift. On four spatial transcriptomics time courses, HORIZON reconstructs tissue geometry, gene expression, and cell abundance more accurately than existing spatial and unbalanced trajectory methods, and interpolates held-out developmental stages.
items.abstract_zh: 从空间转录组快照学习细胞时空动力学，需要跨不同坐标框架建立对应关系；切片的旋转或平移会被误判为细胞运动。作者提出水平流匹配，在共享刚体运动意义下学习组织构型、分子状态和细胞丰度变化。其动力学由连续性—反应方程描述，作用量不惩罚共享刚体运动；水平投影器在学习时从空间预测误差中、生成时从预测速度中去除该分量。等价端点问题在 Wasserstein–Fisher–Rao 几何中联合估计对应与相对位姿，解析路径的速度和生长量作为回归目标。模型 HORIZON 用等变 Transformer 从当前组织预测速度和生长，可由单个初始快照连续生成组织。在受扰动坐标框架的模拟组织和四个空间转录组时间序列上，HORIZON 重建更准确并减少刚体漂移，还能插值留出的发育阶段。
items.highlight_zh: 水平流匹配可在共享刚体运动下学习单细胞时空动态
items.digest_zh: 空间转录组通常只能看到一个个时间点、且不同切片可能处在不同坐标系中的“快照”。如果切片整体旋转或平移，算法很容易把它误当成细胞在移动，从而把真正的生物学变化和坐标误差混在一起。论文要解决的就是：如何在这种共享的刚体运动下，仍然学到组织构型、基因表达状态和细胞数量随时间的真实变化。作者提出“水平流匹配”：把动力学写成连续性—反应方程，但让共享刚体运动不产生代价，并用一个水平投影器把这一分量从预测误差和预测速度中剔除。为了便于计算，他们还把问题转化为 Wasserstein–Fisher–Rao 几何中的端点匹配，得到解析路径，再把路径的速度和生长量作为回归目标。模型 HORIZON 用等变 Transformer 从当前组织预测这些量，因此能从一张初始快照连续生成后续组织。模拟实验显示，先对齐再投影能改善重建并减少刚体漂移；在四个真实空间转录组时间序列上，它比现有空间轨迹和非平衡轨迹方法更准确地重建组织几何、基因表达和细胞丰度，还能补出未观测的发育阶段。意义在于把“坐标框架不确定”纳入模型，而不是事后校正，为单细胞时空建模提供了更稳健的框架。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
items.title_zh: CurvDelta：面向精准学习与遗忘的低曲率增量建模
items.abstract_en: A central challenge in adapting large language models (LLMs) is capability preservation: an adaptation can achieve its target while degrading general capabilities. We introduce CurvDelta, a scalable framework that incorporates the preservation constraint into the parameterization of the model update. By analyzing the local geometry of the preservation constraint around the pre-adaptation model, CurvDelta constructs a low-curvature space in which parameter updates leave the preservation loss nearly invariant. We make its construction practical for LLMs through Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (K-FAC) and a factorized projection. We also introduce CurvLoRA, a low-rank variant within the same preservation geometry, designed for more efficient adaptation. Both methods apply to preservation-constrained adaptation tasks such as capability learning and selective unlearning. We evaluate our methods on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and knowledge unlearning. For mathematical reasoning and code generation, our approaches achieve competitive downstream performance while better preserving general capabilities, offering a favorable acquisition--retention trade-off relative to the baselines. For knowledge unlearning, our main results on TOFU and MUSE show a better balance between targeted forgetting and knowledge retention than the baselines, with retention performance close to the from-scratch retraining reference.
items.abstract_zh: 适配大语言模型（LLM）的核心挑战之一是能力保持：一次适配可能达成目标，却损害通用能力。作者提出 CurvDelta，一个可扩展框架，把保持约束嵌入模型更新的参数化中。通过分析适配前模型附近保持约束的局部几何，CurvDelta 构造一个低曲率空间，使参数更新几乎不改变保持损失。借助 Kronecker 因子近似曲率（K-FAC）和因子化投影，该构造可实用地扩展到 LLM。作者还提出 CurvLoRA，在同一保持几何下的低秩变体，用于更高效的适配。两种方法适用于能力学习和选择性遗忘等保持约束下的适配任务。在数学推理、代码生成和知识遗忘上评估：在数学和代码任务中，下游性能有竞争力，同时更好地保持通用能力，取得更优的习得—保持权衡；在 TOFU 和 MUSE 的知识遗忘上，目标遗忘与知识保持更平衡，保持性能接近从头重训参考。
items.highlight_zh: 把能力保持约束嵌入低曲率参数更新，兼顾学习与遗忘
items.digest_zh: 大模型做微调时常见一个两难：学会了新任务，却把原有能力弄坏；或者做“遗忘”时，连带损失了不该忘的知识。这篇论文把“保持”从训练后的惩罚项，提前写进参数更新的几何结构里。核心想法是：在适配前模型附近观察保持损失如何变化，找到一个“低曲率”子空间，在这个子空间里更新参数，保持损失几乎不变。为了让这件事在大模型上算得动，作者用 K-FAC 近似曲率和因子化投影来构造该空间，并给出低秩版本 CurvLoRA，降低适配成本。方法可用于两类任务：能力学习（如数学推理、代码生成）和选择性遗忘（如删掉某些知识）。实验表明，在数学和代码任务上，下游表现与基线相当，但通用能力保持得更好，说明“学得会”和“不遗忘”之间的权衡更优；在 TOFU、MUSE 遗忘基准上，目标遗忘与知识保持更平衡，保持效果接近从头重训的参考。意义在于提供了一种可扩展的“外科式”适配思路：不是粗暴地压住更新，而是让更新天然避开会破坏已有能力的方向。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: FAST-LIO2: Fast Direct LiDAR-inertial Odometry
items.abstract_en: This paper presents FAST-LIO2: a fast, robust, and versatile LiDAR-inertial odometry framework. Building on a highly efficient tightly-coupled iterated Kalman filter, FAST-LIO2 has two key novelties that allow fast, robust, and accurate LiDAR navigation (and mapping). The first one is directly registering raw points to the map (and subsequently update the map, i.e., mapping) without extracting features. This enables the exploitation of subtle features in the environment and hence increases the accuracy. The elimination of a hand-engineered feature extraction module also makes it naturally adaptable to emerging LiDARs of different scanning patterns; The second main novelty is maintaining a map by an incremental k-d tree data structure, ikd-Tree, that enables incremental updates (i.e., point insertion, delete) and dynamic re-balancing. Compared with existing dynamic data structures (octree, R*-tree, nanoflann k-d tree), ikd-Tree achieves superior overall performance while naturally supports downsampling on the tree. We conduct an exhaustive benchmark comparison in 19 sequences from a variety of open LiDAR datasets. FAST-LIO2 achieves consistently higher accuracy at a much lower computation load than other state-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial navigation systems. Various real-world experiments on solid-state LiDARs with small FoV are also conducted. Overall, FAST-LIO2 is computationally-efficient (e.g., up to 100 Hz odometry and mapping in large outdoor environments), robust (e.g., reliable pose estimation in cluttered indoor environments with rotation up to 1000 deg/s), versatile (i.e., applicable to both multi-line spinning and solid-state LiDARs, UAV and handheld platforms, and Intel and ARM-based processors), while still achieving higher accuracy than existing methods. Our implementation of the system FAST-LIO2, and the data structure ikd-Tree are both open-sourced on Github.

reference_review.reason_zh: 直接点云配准的激光惯性里程计与作者实现，可用于定位系统的实时性和鲁棒性比较。

items.title_zh: FAST-LIO2：快速直接 LiDAR 惯性里程计
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 FAST-LIO2：一个快速、鲁棒且通用的 LiDAR 惯性里程计框架。它基于高效紧耦合迭代卡尔曼滤波，并有两个关键创新。第一，直接将原始点云配准到地图并更新地图，无需提取特征，从而能利用环境细微特征提高精度，也自然适配不同扫描模式的新兴 LiDAR。第二，用增量 k-d 树 ikd-Tree 维护地图，支持点插入、删除和动态重平衡；与八叉树、R*-树、nanoflann k-d 树相比总体性能更优，并天然支持树上降采样。作者在多个公开 LiDAR 数据集的 19 个序列上进行基准比较，FAST-LIO2 以更低计算量持续获得更高精度；还在小视场固态 LiDAR 上开展真实实验。总体而言，它计算高效（大型户外环境最高 100 Hz）、鲁棒（杂乱室内旋转达 1000 deg/s 仍可靠）、通用（多线旋转与固态 LiDAR、无人机与手持平台、Intel 与 ARM 处理器），且精度高于现有方法。
items.highlight_zh: 免特征提取的直接点云配准与增量 ikd-Tree 建图
items.digest_zh: LiDAR 惯性里程计要回答的是：机器人在移动时，如何根据激光雷达点云和惯性测量单元，实时估计自己的位姿并同时建图。传统方法往往先提取角点、面点等特征，再把特征与地图匹配；特征提取既增加计算，也可能丢掉环境中有用的细节，还会绑定某类扫描模式。FAST-LIO2 的两个关键改动正是针对这些痛点：一是“直接法”，把原始点云直接配准到地图，不再依赖手工特征，因此能利用细微结构，也更容易适配不同扫描方式的激光雷达；二是用增量 k-d 树 ikd-Tree 管理地图，支持点的插入、删除和动态重平衡，还能在树上做降采样，使地图维护更高效。作者在多个公开数据集的 19 个序列上做了系统比较，结果显示它在计算量更低的情况下精度更高；在小视场固态 LiDAR 上也做了真实实验。最终系统能在大型户外环境达到最高 100 Hz 的里程计与建图，在杂乱室内即使旋转高达 1000 deg/s 仍能可靠估计位姿，并支持多线旋转和固态 LiDAR、无人机/手持平台以及 Intel/ARM 处理器。意义在于把“快、稳、通用”同时做到，为机器人实时导航提供了实用基础。

items.title_en: RoughCut-Bench: A Benchmark for Automatic Video Rough-Cut with Large Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: RoughCut-Bench：面向大视觉语言模型的自动视频粗剪基准
items.abstract_en: Video rough-cut is a core stage in media production workflows, organizing raw media materials into an initial video cut. Despite recent advances in large vision-language models (LVLMs) for video-related tasks, automatic rough-cut remains underexplored, without a comprehensive benchmark for evaluation or mature workflows for producing executable cut plans. To address the evaluation gap, we introduce RoughCut-Bench, which covers two practical settings: (1) a visually driven setting over video cases, covering highlight detection and selection, source-video ordering, and adherence to user requirements when provided; and (2) a speech-driven setting over automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcripts, covering filler removal, expression deduplication, and low-value content trimming. Across these settings, the benchmark contains 101 visually driven cases, including 831 raw videos with 1,476 highlight annotations. It also includes 84 speech-driven cases, each consisting of an ASR transcript with annotated cleanup spans. The evaluation compares cut plans with these annotations in both settings and additionally uses a human-aligned agentic evaluator to assess rendered-cut quality in the visual setting. To apply LVLMs to automatic rough-cut, we further propose agentic workflows that guide them to produce structured cut plans from input materials. Experiments show that current LVLMs remain limited in producing expert-aligned cut plans. Our benchmark, code, and prompts are released at https://whalesong-zrs.github.io/RoughCut-Bench-Project-Page.
items.abstract_zh: 视频粗剪是媒体制作流程的核心环节，负责将原始素材组织成初剪版本。尽管大视觉语言模型（LVLM）在视频任务上已有进展，自动粗剪仍缺乏系统性探索，既无全面的评测基准，也缺少能产出可执行剪辑方案的成熟流程。为填补评测空白，我们提出 RoughCut-Bench，覆盖两种实际设定：（1）视觉驱动设定，基于视频案例，考察高光检测与选取、源视频排序以及对用户要求的遵循；（2）语音驱动设定，基于自动语音识别（ASR）转写文本，考察口头填充词去除、重复表达去重与低价值内容裁剪。基准共含 101 个视觉驱动案例（831 段原始视频、1476 条高光标注）和 84 个语音驱动案例（每例含带清理片段标注的 ASR 转写）。评测在两种设定下将剪辑方案与标注比对，视觉设定中另用与人类对齐的智能体评估器评价渲染成片质量。我们进一步提出智能体式（agentic）工作流，引导 LVLM 从输入材料生成结构化剪辑方案。实验表明，现有 LVLM 仍难以产出与专家一致的剪辑方案。
items.highlight_zh: 首个视频粗剪双设定评测基准，并揭示LVLM尚难对齐专家
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：视频“粗剪”是把大量原始素材整理成初剪版本的关键一步，长期依赖人工。大视觉语言模型虽能做视频问答、描述等任务，但“自动粗剪”一直没有公认的评测标准，也没有成熟流程能把模型输出变成真正可执行的剪辑方案。
2）用了什么方法：作者构建 RoughCut-Bench，分成两类贴近真实的场景。视觉驱动场景给出原始视频，要求模型挑出高光片段、排好源视频顺序、并遵守用户提出的要求；这部分包含 101 个案例、831 段原始视频和 1476 条高光标注。语音驱动场景基于 ASR 转写文本，要求删掉“嗯、啊”等填充词、去掉重复表达、裁掉低价值内容；共 84 个案例，每份转写都标出了应清理的片段。评测时把模型给出的剪辑方案与人工标注对照，视觉场景还额外用一个与人类判断对齐的智能体评估器给渲染出的成片打分。此外，作者提出智能体式工作流，引导 LVLM 输出结构化的剪辑方案。
3）有什么结果：实验显示，当前主流 LVLM 生成的剪辑方案与专家做法仍有明显差距。
4）为何重要：它第一次为自动粗剪提供了可量化比较的公共基准和评测协议，并把“模型能力”与“可执行剪辑流程”连起来，为后续研究和实际制作工具打下基础。基准、代码与提示词均已公开。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: AIO Part I: Interpretable ADMET Prediction for Cyclic Peptides and Macrocycles
items.title_zh: AIO 第一部分：面向环肽与大环分子的可解释 ADMET 预测
items.abstract_en: Macrocycles and cyclic peptides are increasingly important in beyond-rule-of-five (bRo5) drug discovery, yet their absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) properties remain difficult to predict owing to sparse data, complex topology, and environment-dependent conformations. Here, we present AIO (All-in-One), an interpretable multimodal ADMET framework combining topology-preserving molecular segmentation with solvent-aware contrastive pretraining. Across repeated cross-validation, AIO performed strongly across permeability, solubility, unbound fraction, clearance, half-life, bioavailability, and toxicity endpoints, achieving Pearson R = 0.87 for PAMPA permeability and AUROC = 0.91 for bioavailability. Case studies of recently approved macrocyclic and cyclic-peptide drugs showed agreement between predictions and reported pharmacokinetic profiles, while segment-level attribution highlighted molecular regions associated with predicted ADMET bottlenecks. Despite pretraining exclusively on macrocycles, AIO also transferred competitively to the small-molecule PharmaBench dataset. These results establish a promising foundation for interpretable ADMET prediction across diverse molecular modalities in drug discovery.
items.abstract_zh: 大环分子与环肽在“超越类药五规则”（bRo5）的药物发现中日益重要，但其吸收、分布、代谢、排泄与毒性（ADMET）性质因数据稀疏、拓扑结构复杂以及依赖环境的构象变化而难以预测。本文提出 AIO（All-in-One），一个可解释的多模态 ADMET 框架，将拓扑保持的分子分割与溶剂感知的对比预训练相结合。在重复交叉验证中，AIO 在渗透性、溶解度、游离分数、清除率、半衰期、生物利用度与毒性终点上均表现强劲，PAMPA 渗透性达到 Pearson R = 0.87，生物利用度 AUROC = 0.91。对近期获批的大环与环肽药物的案例研究表明，预测结果与已报道的药代动力学特征一致，片段级归因还能标出与预测 ADMET 瓶颈相关的分子区域。尽管仅在大环分子上预训练，AIO 也能有效迁移到小分子数据集 PharmaBench。
items.highlight_zh: 可解释多模态框架AIO，兼顾环肽ADMET精度与片段级归因
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：大环分子和环肽是近年“超越类药五规则”（bRo5）药物研发的热点，分子量大、结构复杂。但预测它们在体内的吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）非常困难：可用数据少、环状拓扑复杂、构象还会随溶剂环境变化。
2）用了什么方法：作者提出 AIO（All-in-One）框架，思路有两点。一是“拓扑保持的分子分割”，把分子切成片段时不破坏环系与连接关系，使模型既能看整体也能看局部；二是“溶剂感知的对比预训练”，让分子表示对环境（如水相/有机相）敏感，贴近真实构象变化。整个框架是多模态、可解释的。
3）有什么结果：在重复交叉验证中，AIO 在渗透性、溶解度、游离分数、清除率、半衰期、生物利用度和毒性等多个终点上都表现良好，其中 PAMPA 渗透性的 Pearson R 达 0.87，生物利用度 AUROC 达 0.91。对近期获批的大环与环肽药物做案例研究，预测与文献报道的药代动力学特征吻合；片段级归因还能指出哪些分子局部是 ADMET 的“瓶颈”。一个意外收获是，尽管只在大环分子上预训练，它迁移到小分子数据集 PharmaBench 上依然有竞争力。
4）为何重要：它说明可解释的 ADMET 预测不仅能给出数值，还能告诉化学家“问题出在分子哪一块”，并且能跨分子类型迁移，为 bRo5 药物设计提供了实用基础。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Beyond Corpus-Driven Imitation: Evolving Musical Mindsets in the Agentic Orchestra via Quantum Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 超越语料驱动的模仿：量子强化学习下智能体管弦乐团的音乐心态演化
items.abstract_en: This paper presents a framework for computer-aided music composition and performance based on quantum reinforcement learning and multi-agent interaction. We introduce the agentic orchestra, where musical agents evolve distinct mindsets through trial-and-error engagement with a musical environment, rather than through training on large datasets. The agents are implemented as parameterised quantum circuits. They evolve distinct compositional behaviours, referred to as mindsets. This enables the exploration of musical decision spaces using quantum superposition and entanglement within a hybrid quantum-classical loop. We present two complementary agent architectures: atomistic agents, which process pitch and rhythm independently, and holistic agents, which handle pitch and duration as unified note events. Mindsets are shaped through musically grounded reward functions, which can be combined and weighted to develop different mindsets across agents. The resulting system positions quantum computing agents less as autonomous composers and more as adaptive musical partners, each developing its own musical personality through interaction rather than imitation. Demonstrations show how agents generalise their learned behaviour to previously unseen material, operating in interactive and offline batch modes using MIDI-encoded music. While quantum computers are still in development, experiments conducted on IBM quantum hardware confirmed that musically meaningful learning is achievable with existing quantum computers. For composers and performers, the agentic orchestra opens new possibilities for emergent, process-oriented musical creativity, offering a scalable foundation for quantum computer-aided music composition as quantum computing technology continues to advance.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个基于量子强化学习与多智能体交互的计算机辅助音乐创作与演奏框架。我们引入“智能体管弦乐团”，其中音乐智能体通过与音乐环境反复试错，而非在大规模数据集上训练，演化出各自不同的“心态”。智能体以参数化量子电路实现，在混合量子—经典回路中利用量子叠加与纠缠探索音乐决策空间，从而演化出不同的作曲行为（即心态）。我们给出两种互补的智能体架构：原子式智能体分别处理音高与节奏，整体式智能体则把音高与时值视为统一的音符事件。心态由具有音乐依据的奖励函数塑造，这些奖励可组合与加权，以在不同智能体上发展出不同心态。该系统把量子计算智能体定位为自适应的音乐伙伴而非自主作曲家，各自通过交互而非模仿形成音乐个性。演示表明智能体能将所学行为泛化到此前未见的材料，并以交互或离线批处理模式处理 MIDI 编码音乐。尽管量子计算仍在发展，在 IBM 量子硬件上的实验确认，现有量子计算机已能实现具有音乐意义的学习。
items.highlight_zh: 用参数化量子电路智能体试错演化出各自的音乐“心态”
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：现有 AI 作曲大多靠学习海量音乐语料来“模仿”人类风格。作者问：能否让智能体不靠大语料，而是通过与环境互动试错，长出自己的音乐偏好和判断方式（文中称为“心态”）？
2）用了什么方法：作者搭建“智能体管弦乐团”，每个音乐智能体由一个参数化量子电路实现，在混合量子—经典回路中利用量子叠加与纠缠来探索音乐决策空间，并用强化学习更新参数。智能体有两种架构：原子式把音高和节奏分开处理；整体式把音高与时值当作一个统一的“音符事件”。训练信号不是模仿目标，而是有音乐依据的奖励函数，这些奖励可以组合、加权，不同权重会养出不同心态。
3）有什么结果：智能体演化出彼此不同的作曲行为，并能把学到的行为泛化到此前没见过的音乐材料；系统支持交互式演奏和离线批处理两种模式，输入输出均为 MIDI 编码音乐。作者还在 IBM 的真实量子硬件上做了实验，确认现有量子计算机已能完成对音乐有意义的学习，尽管规模仍受硬件限制。
4）为何重要：它把量子智能体定位成“会成长的音乐伙伴”而不是自动作曲机，为过程性、涌现式的音乐创作提供了新范式，也为量子计算在创意领域的应用给出了可扩展的雏形。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Latent Action Policies from Suboptimal Data
items.title_zh: 从次优数据中学习潜动作策略
items.abstract_en: Latent Action Models (LAMs) learn control representations from action-free video, but existing pipelines typically train latent policies with behavioral cloning, without an explicit policy improvement objective. Although offline RL offers a natural approach to policy improvement, standard methods do not transfer directly to learned latent action spaces. We find that the structure of learned latent actions makes naive offline RL unreliable: directly maximizing value over latent actions or fitting a unimodal policy can produce latent actions that cannot be realized by physical execution, while the latent representation can merge physical controls that receive different rewards. To understand when latent-space optimization remains valid, we derive conditions under which policy improvement transfers to decoded execution and under which latent and physical optima align. Building on these insights, we propose LAPIS for goal-conditioned latent policy improvement, grounding value-based policy improvement in observed state-latent transitions and using a conditional flow policy to capture their multimodal structure. LAPIS outperforms baselines on most tasks, with the clearest gains in visual manipulation, and remains effective even with only 1% action labels, where competing methods largely collapse.
items.abstract_zh: 潜动作模型（LAM）可从无动作标注的视频中学习控制表示，但现有流程通常只用行为克隆训练潜策略，缺少显式的策略改进目标。离线强化学习（RL）天然适合策略改进，然而标准方法并不能直接迁移到学习得到的潜动作空间。我们发现，潜动作的结构会使朴素的离线 RL 不可靠：直接在潜动作上最大化价值或拟合单峰策略，可能产生物理执行无法实现的潜动作；潜表示还可能把获得不同奖励的物理控制合并在一起。为厘清潜空间优化何时仍然有效，我们推导了策略改进可迁移到解码执行的成立条件，以及潜最优与物理最优对齐的条件。基于这些分析，我们提出 LAPIS，用于目标条件潜策略改进：它把基于价值的策略改进锚定在观测到的“状态—潜动作”转移上，并用条件流策略刻画其多模态结构。LAPIS 在多数任务上优于基线，在视觉操作任务上增益最明显；即使只有 1% 的动作标签，它依然有效，而对比方法大多崩溃。
items.highlight_zh: LAPIS把离线RL安全地搬到潜动作空间，仅1%动作标签仍有效
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：机器人学习常面临动作标签昂贵的问题。潜动作模型（LAM）能从没有动作标注的视频里学出一套“潜动作”表示，但现有做法下游只用行为克隆——即照抄数据里的行为，没有主动“改进策略”。离线强化学习本可用于改进，可是直接搬到潜动作空间往往失效。
2）关键发现：作者指出两处结构性问题。其一，潜动作是学出来的，直接在其上最大化价值、或拟合一个单峰策略，可能给出物理上根本执行不出来的动作；其二，潜表示可能把奖励不同、但看起来相似的物理控制合并成同一个潜动作，导致优化方向错误。为此他们推导了两个条件：策略改进在什么条件下能迁移到解码后的真实执行，潜空间最优在什么条件下与物理最优一致。
3）用了什么方法：基于上述分析，提出 LAPIS，做目标条件的潜策略改进。它把基于价值的策略改进“锚定”在数据中真实观测到的状态—潜动作转移上，避免凭空生成不可执行的潜动作；再用条件流策略捕捉潜动作的多模态结构，而不是强行压成单峰分布。
4）有什么结果：LAPIS 在多数任务上超过基线方法，视觉操作任务提升最明显；在只有 1% 动作标签的极低监督下仍然有效，而对比方法大多性能崩溃。
5）为何重要：它给了“大量无标注视频 + 极少量动作标签”这一现实场景一条可行的策略改进路径，同时把潜空间优化的可靠性问题从经验试错推进到有理论条件的分析。

items.title_en: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
items.title_zh: Piccolo：通过递归自我改进协同演化决策模型与数据
items.abstract_en: We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI). The models predict probabilities over candidate answers for general-purpose text and visual judgments, agent harnesses, data workflows, and interactive games. Piccolo-27B tops the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard with a score of 75.59, while Piccolo-9B and Piccolo-4B achieve 68.35 and 67.46, respectively. All three rank first on the Private benchmark in their respective model-size categories. Research agents analyze model behavior, construct training data, conduct experiments, and use the results to refine subsequent proposals. Semantic slices and a shared research memory connect these actions across the model family's development. With training recipes comprising hundreds of thousands of examples, data selection and feedback-driven refinement are central to the self-improvement process. Our large-scale RSI exploration yields three counter-intuitive insights for decision-model development: (1) Backbone-recipe co-adaptation outweighs raw model recency: earlier backbones can surpass newer generations on visual tasks under identical recipes; (2) Targeted data curation enables 4B-9B models to rival 27B baselines on specialized workflows; and (3) Continuous loss reduction can decouple from and even degrade discrete decision accuracy. Together with the released weights and tools from the Data-Juicer and AgentScope ecosystems, Piccolo provides an actionable blueprint for building frontier decision models and scaling data-driven RSI.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Piccolo，一族多模态决策模型（0.8B 至 27B），通过智能体数据工程（Agentic Data Engineering）与递归自我改进（RSI）让模型能力与训练数据协同演化。模型对候选答案预测概率分布，覆盖通用文本与视觉判断、智能体框架、数据工作流与交互式游戏。Piccolo-27B 以 75.59 分位居 Decision Index Vision Full 榜首，Piccolo-9B 与 Piccolo-4B 分别为 68.35 与 67.46，三者均在各自参数规模的 Private 榜单排名第一。研究智能体分析模型行为、构建训练数据、开展实验，并用实验结论改进后续提案，语义切片与共享研究记忆把这些环节串联起来。大规模 RSI 探索给出三点反直觉洞见：骨干与配方协同适配比模型新旧更重要；定向数据策管可使 4B–9B 模型在专用工作流上媲美 27B 基线；损失持续下降可能与离散决策准确率脱钩，甚至使其变差。
items.highlight_zh: 决策模型与训练数据递归共演化，27B 版本登顶决策榜
items.digest_zh:
· 研究问题：如何让“决策模型”（对候选答案给出概率，用于文本/视觉判断、智能体工具调用、数据工作流、游戏等）持续变强？作者把答案押在“模型与数据共同演化”上。
· 方法：提出 Piccolo 系列（0.8B–27B 多模态决策模型），核心是智能体数据工程加递归自我改进（RSI）。研究智能体负责分析模型行为、构造训练数据、跑实验，再把实验结果反馈到下一轮提案；“语义切片”与共享的研究记忆把跨模型规模的经验串起来。训练配方由数十万条样本构成，数据筛选与反馈驱动的迭代是自我改进的关键。
· 结果：Piccolo-27B 在 Decision Index Vision Full 榜以 75.59 分登顶，9B 与 4B 分别为 68.35 与 67.46，三者在各自规模档的 Private 榜均列第一。作者还总结出三条反直觉发现：①骨干与训练配方的“协同适配”比模型新旧更重要——相同配方下，较老的骨干在视觉任务上也可能反超新一代；②精细的数据策管能让 4B–9B 模型在专用工作流上对标 27B 基线；③训练损失持续下降，未必带来离散决策准确率提升，甚至可能使其变差。
· 为何重要：它说明在决策类任务上，“数据怎么造、怎么选”可能比“模型多大、多新”更关键，并给出可复用的工具链（Data-Juicer、AgentScope 生态）与权重，为数据驱动的自我改进提供了可操作蓝图。

items.title_en: HINT-WAM: Hindsight-Informed Training for World Action Models
items.title_zh: HINT-WAM：面向世界动作模型的事后信息引导训练
items.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) have shown promising generalization and data efficiency in robot manipulation by coupling action generation with predictions of future visual dynamics. Translating these capabilities into reliable task execution, however, remains a challenge for existing post-training methods. Offline supervised fine-tuning provides dense supervision on expert trajectories, but its flow-matching action expert is trained only on noised demonstration actions and never on the intermediate states produced by its own sampler; task-specific adaptation can also compromise pretrained capabilities. On-policy reinforcement learning trains on the policy's own behavior, yet sparse task rewards make exploration and credit assignment difficult, while dense reward shaping still provides scalar evaluations rather than direct action targets. We introduce \textbf{HINT-WAM}, the first on-policy self-distillation framework that supervises the action expert on its own sampling trajectories using hindsight, the future video of the demonstration, as privileged information available to the WAM itself. For each demonstration observation, the student generates its action through its own denoising trajectory, and at the states along this trajectory the same model acts as a teacher conditioned additionally on this hindsight, providing a conditional action distribution as a dense training target, while the student sees only deployment-time inputs and needs no environmental rewards or simulator interaction. To transfer this supervision to a flow-matching action expert, HINT-WAM distills the teacher into the student with an energy score, a distribution-level objective that matches the teacher's action distribution from the student's own samples rather than regressing its velocity field. The project web is available in https://tuandattt.github.io/hintwam/.
items.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型（WAM）将动作生成与对未来视觉动态的预测耦合，在机器人操作中展现出良好的泛化性与数据效率，但现有后训练方法仍难以把它转化为可靠的任务执行。离线监督微调能在专家轨迹上提供稠密监督，但其 flow-matching 动作专家只在加噪的示范动作上训练，从未见过自身采样器产生的中间状态，任务特化还可能损害预训练能力。在线强化学习用策略自身行为训练，然而任务奖励稀疏使探索与信用分配困难，稠密奖励塑形给出的也只是标量评价而非直接动作目标。我们提出 HINT-WAM，首个同策略自蒸馏框架：以演示的未来视频作为 WAM 自身可得的特权信息（事后信息），在动作专家自己的采样轨迹上对其监督。对每个演示观测，学生通过自身去噪轨迹生成动作，在轨迹沿途状态上同一模型作为教师，额外以该事后信息为条件输出条件动作分布作为稠密训练目标；学生只看到部署时输入，无需环境奖励或模拟器交互。为迁移到 flow-matching 动作专家，HINT-WAM 采用分布级的能量分数目标，从学生自身样本匹配教师的动作分布，而非回归其速度场。
items.highlight_zh: 首个用未来视频作事后信息、在线自蒸馏微调机器人策略的框架
items.digest_zh:
· 研究问题：世界动作模型（WAM）把动作生成与未来视觉动态预测耦合，泛化与数据效率不错，但要让它在具体任务上稳定执行仍很困难。现有后训练手段各有短板：离线监督微调用专家轨迹给稠密监督，可动作专家只在加噪的示范动作上训练，从未见过自己采样器产生的中间状态，任务特化还可能损害预训练能力；在线强化学习能用自己的行为训练，但任务奖励稀疏，探索与信用分配都难，稠密奖励塑形给的也只是标量评分，而非直接的动作目标。
· 方法：作者提出 HINT-WAM，首个“同策略自蒸馏”框架。对每个演示观测，学生模型走一遍自己的去噪轨迹生成动作；在这条轨迹沿途的状态上，同一个模型化身教师，额外以“事后信息”——该演示的未来视频——为条件，输出条件动作分布作为稠密监督目标。学生始终只看到部署时可得的输入，既不需要环境奖励，也不需要与模拟器交互。
· 关键技术：要把这种监督注入 flow-matching 动作专家，不能简单回归教师的速度场；HINT-WAM 改用“能量分数”这一分布级目标，从学生自己的采样出发去匹配教师的动作分布。
· 为何重要：它把“未来视频”这种仅在训练时可得的特权信息，转化为不依赖奖励设计的稠密、动作级监督，为 WAM 的任务适配提供了一条既充分利用示范、又贴合自身采样分布的路径。

items.title_en: PReMind: When Personal Memory Meets Visual Hazards
items.title_zh: PReMind：当个人记忆遇上视觉危险
items.abstract_en: Personalized vision-language assistants use visual observations and personal memories to provide advice tailored to the user. When the observed scene contains a physical hazard, personal context, such as allergies, medical conditions, or mobility constraints, can change what help is appropriate. Responding appropriately therefore requires recognizing the visible hazard and applying the relevant person's information. We introduce PReMind-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that evaluates this combination across diverse hazards and personal-memory conditions. It separately measures memory access, grounding, abstention, and hazard response, and assesses joint success on interdependency cases. Existing models often satisfy one requirement while failing the other, and training only for safety or personalization leaves a gap in joint success. We therefore propose PReMind, a two-phase reinforcement learning framework that combines on-demand and forced-call interactions (memory always retrieved) to jointly train grounded memory use and hazard response. At 4B, PReMind raises joint success from 12.9% to 28.6% over its base on the interdependency set and improves hazard adequacy and correct abstention on the main test. Joint-success gains persist under forced-call evaluation and under a second LLM judge across three Phase II seeds; averaged over these seeds, joint success also improves on unseen hazard groups. These findings highlight the need to evaluate and train personal assistants to connect visual evidence with the relevant person's context.
items.abstract_zh: 个性化视觉语言助手利用视觉观察和个人记忆，提供针对用户定制的建议。当观察到的场景包含物理危险时，个人情境（如过敏、疾病状况或行动能力限制）会改变何种帮助是合适的。因此，要作出恰当响应，需要识别可见危险并应用相关个人的信息。我们推出 PReMind-Bench，一个诊断性基准，用于在多种危险和个人记忆条件下评估这种组合。它分别衡量记忆访问、grounding、弃答和危险响应，并评估相互依赖案例上的联合成功率。现有模型常常满足一项要求却未满足另一项，而仅针对安全性或个性化进行训练会在联合成功率上留下差距。因此，我们提出 PReMind，一个两阶段强化学习框架，结合按需调用与强制调用交互（始终检索记忆），以联合训练有依据的记忆使用和危险响应。在 4B 规模下，PReMind 在相互依赖集上将联合成功率相对其基座从 12.9% 提升至 28.6%，并在主测试上改善危险应对充分性和正确弃答。联合成功率增益在强制调用评估下、以及在由第二个 LLM 评判器评估时跨三个 Phase II 种子均持续存在；在这些种子上取平均，联合成功率在未见危险组上也有所提升。这些发现凸显了评估和训练个人助手将视觉证据与相关个人情境相联系的必要性。

items.title_en: PDAC BioPortal: An Integrated Web Resource for Multi-Scale Analysis of Pancreatic Cancer Transcriptomics
items.title_zh: PDAC BioPortal：用于胰腺癌转录组学多尺度分析的综合网络资源
items.abstract_en: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) exhibits extensive molecular heterogeneity and undergoes substantial transcriptional remodeling across disease and treatment contexts. However, publicly available PDAC transcriptomic resources remain fragmented across experimental modalities, limiting the integrated investigation of molecular programs across biological scales and cellular compartments. Here, we developed PDAC BioPortal, an integrated web-based analytical resource for multimodal interrogation of PDAC transcriptomics. The platform incorporates bulk RNA sequencing, treatment-associated transcriptomics, single-nucleus RNA sequencing, and spatial transcriptomics. It integrates 349 TCGA-GTEx samples, including a primary tumor-versus-normal comparison of 178 PDAC tumors and 167 normal pancreas specimens; a clinically annotated treatment-associated cohort of 55 specimens (GSE225767); a single-nucleus atlas comprising 224,988 nuclei from 43 patients (GSE202051); and spatial transcriptomic profiles encompassing 23,436 tissue spots from five patients (GSE274103). The platform provides interactive differential expression analysis, over-representation analysis, gene set enrichment analysis, patient-aware pseudobulk comparisons, cell-type-resolved interrogation, and spatial gene-expression visualization. It additionally incorporates PDACopilot, an evidence-grounded natural-language interface connecting user queries with structured datasets and precomputed analytical results. Application of the platform revealed distinct transcriptional architectures across disease and treatment contexts. Primary PDAC exhibited prominent proliferation-associated, inflammatory, and epithelial-mesenchymal transition-related programs, whereas specimens obtained following neoadjuvant chemotherapy and stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT) showed prominent mesenchymal, collagen, and extracellular matrix-associated signatures. Comparison of independent bulk and single-nucleus treatment-associated datasets demonstrated significant pathway rank-order concordance, despite limited linear correlation. Focused interrogation of the NRF2-associated redox network revealed broad transcriptional elevation in primary PDAC, involving antioxidant-response, glutathione metabolism, and NADPH-generating genes. Treatment-associated bulk transcriptomes exhibited selective remodeling of individual network components rather than uniform expression changes. At single-nucleus resolution, NFE2L2 expression exhibited cell-type-dependent patterns, with significant patient-level increases in selected vascular, immune, and endocrine populations across the neoadjuvant-treated cohort and reduced expression in malignant epithelial cells in the standard chemoradiotherapy subgroup. Spatial profiling further revealed interpatient variation in NFE2L2 transcript distribution across treatment-naive PDAC tissues, with differences in the proportion of positive spots despite comparatively consistent expression intensity among positive spots. Higher expression of a selected six-gene NRF2-associated signature was also associated with shorter overall survival, providing an exploratory link between redox-associated transcriptional patterns and clinical outcome. Together, PDAC BioPortal provides an integrated analytical infrastructure for investigating PDAC transcriptional programs across complementary cohorts and biological resolutions. By combining interactive bioinformatics capabilities with evidence-grounded AI-assisted exploration, the platform facilitates cross-dataset molecular interpretation and hypothesis generation while distinguishing transcriptional associations from mechanistic evidence.
items.abstract_zh: 胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）表现出广泛的分子异质性，并在疾病和治疗背景下经历显著的转录重塑。然而，公开可用的 PDAC 转录组资源仍分散于不同实验模态中，限制了跨生物学尺度和细胞区室的分子程序整合研究。在此，我们开发了 PDAC BioPortal，一个用于 PDAC 转录组多模态解析的集成式网络分析资源。该平台整合了批量 RNA 测序、治疗相关转录组学、单核 RNA 测序和空间转录组学。它整合了 349 个 TCGA-GTEx 样本，包括 178 个 PDAC 肿瘤与 167 个正常胰腺标本的原发肿瘤对正常比较；一个经临床注释的 55 份标本治疗相关队列（GSE225767）；一个包含来自 43 名患者的 224,988 个细胞核的单核图谱（GSE202051）；以及包含来自 5 名患者的 23,436 个组织斑点的空间转录组图谱（GSE274103）。平台提供交互式差异表达分析、过表征分析、基因集富集分析、患者感知的伪批量比较、细胞类型解析的探查和空间基因表达可视化。它还整合了 PDACopilot，一个以证据为基础的自然语言接口，将用户查询与结构化数据集和预计算分析结果连接起来。平台应用揭示了不同疾病和治疗背景下不同的转录架构。原发 PDAC 表现出显著的增殖相关、炎症和上皮-间质转化相关程序，而新辅助化疗和立体定向体部放疗（SBRT）后获得的标本显示出显著的间充质、胶原和细胞外基质相关特征。对独立的批量与单核治疗相关数据集的比较表明，尽管线性相关性有限，通路排序具有显著一致性。对 NRF2 相关氧化还原网络的聚焦探查显示，原发 PDAC 中广泛的转录升高，涉及抗氧化反应、谷胱甘肽代谢和 NADPH 生成基因。治疗相关批量转录组表现出单个网络组分的选择性重塑，而非一致的表达变化。在单核分辨率下，NFE2L2 表达呈现细胞类型依赖模式：在新辅助治疗队列中，选定的血管、免疫和内分泌群体在患者水平显著增加，而在标准化放化疗亚组中恶性上皮细胞表达降低。空间分析进一步揭示，在初治 PDAC 组织中，NFE2L2 转录本分布存在患者间差异，尽管阳性斑点的表达强度相对一致，但阳性斑点比例存在差异。选定的六基因 NRF2 相关特征较高表达也与较短总生存期相关，提供了氧化还原相关转录模式与临床结果之间的探索性联系。总之，PDAC BioPortal 提供了集成的分析基础设施，用于跨互补队列和生物分辨率研究 PDAC 转录程序。通过将交互式生物信息学能力与基于证据的 AI 辅助探索相结合，该平台促进跨数据集分子解释和假设生成，同时区分转录关联与机制证据。

items.title_en: Observation of room-temperature intrinsic antiferroelectricity in van der Waals NbOCl2
items.title_zh: 范德华 NbOCl2 中室温本征反铁电性的观测
items.abstract_en: In recent years, two-dimensional (2D) ferroelectricity has been extensively investigated across a wide range of 2D materials, while intrinsic 2D antiferroelectricity remains exceptionally rare, limiting its implementation in next-generation photonic and electronic devices. Here, we report the observation of room-temperature-stable antiferroelectricity in the layered transition metal oxyhalide NbOCl2, and demonstrate a reversible, stimuli-driven antiferroelectric-to-ferroelectric (AFE-to-FE) phase transition in this material. Second-harmonic generation (SHG) mapping reveals a well-defined stripe-like spatial distribution of SHG intensity across as-grown NbOCl2 flakes spanning thickness from few-layer to bulk-like configurations. This distinctive SHG signature originates from the existence of antiferroelectric phase and the coexistence of antiferroelectric and ferroelectric phases within individual crystals, as evidenced by a combined incident-angle-dependent SHG measurement and Raman spectroscopy. By integrating NbOCl2 with one-dimensional silver nanowires, we achieve spatially selective, strain-mediated AFE-to-FE phase transition. Moreover, an ultralow electric field (~20 kV/cm) induces a reversible SHG response, consistent with switching from the centrosymmetric antiferroelectric state (SHG-silent) to the non-centrosymmetric ferroelectric state (SHG-active). This study not only expands the family of room-temperature 2D antiferroelectrics but also establishes a versatile platform for dynamic manipulation of nonlinear light, paving the way toward electric-field-programmable nonlinear photonics and optical information processing.
items.abstract_zh: 近年来，二维（2D）铁电性已在广泛的二维材料中得到广泛研究，而本征二维反铁电性仍然极为罕见，限制了其在下一代光子和电子器件中的实现。在此，我们报道在层状过渡金属氧卤化物 NbOCl2 中观察到室温稳定的反铁电性，并展示该材料中可逆的、刺激驱动的反铁电到铁电（AFE-to-FE）相变。二次谐波产生（SHG）映射显示，在从少层到类体块构型的生长态 NbOCl2 薄片中，SHG 强度呈现明确的条纹状空间分布。这种独特的 SHG 特征源于反铁电相的存在以及单个晶体内反铁电相与铁电相的共存，这由入射角依赖 SHG 测量与拉曼光谱相结合所证实。通过将 NbOCl2 与一维银纳米线集成，我们实现了空间选择性的、应变介导的 AFE-to-FE 相变。此外，超低电场（约 20 kV/cm）诱导可逆 SHG 响应，与从中心对称反铁电态（SHG 静默）切换到非中心对称铁电态（SHG 活性）一致。这项研究不仅扩展了室温二维反铁电体家族，还建立了一个动态操控非线性光的通用平台，为电场可编程非线性光子学和光信息处理铺平道路。

items.title_en: Hardware Acceleration of Vision-Language-Action Models with Weight Precision Rising over the Flow Steps
items.title_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型的硬件加速：权重精度随流匹配步数递增
items.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models such as GR00T control robots through an action head: a diffusion transformer that turns noise into a chunk of actions in a few flow-matching steps. Every step re-reads all of the head's weights from DRAM but applies each weight to only about fifty tokens. Inference is therefore memory-bound, and its latency and energy are largely determined by the total number of transferred weight bits. We show that later flow steps attenuate the quantization errors of earlier steps, so the weight precision of an action head should rise over the steps. With plain per-channel rounding and without calibration or training, widths rising over the steps from 2 to 4 bits preserve the closed-loop success of robot policies. These widths transfer 25% fewer bits than 4-bit weights at every step. However, we show that on Jetson AGX Thor, current GPU kernels cannot exploit this per-step precision due to fixed overheads. We therefore present a programmable accelerator whose latency and energy both scale with the transferred weight bits. It decodes entropy-coded weights for bit-serial sub-arrays at the DRAM rate. Because the width changes per step, a run-time allocator divides these sub-arrays between the linear layers and the attention to balance their workloads. The same sub-arrays are thus capable of running action heads of different families and sizes, as well as a vision-language model. On the DRAM side, a requantizer and an entropy encoder at each bank let one stored 8-bit copy replace the copies of all widths. Simulated with LPDDR5X timing, our RTL implementation runs the GR00T N1.6 action head in 8.02 ms per inference with 2, 3, 3 and 4 bits in its four flow steps. With a copy per width and 50% of Thor's memory bandwidth, the accelerator runs this schedule 1.7x faster than Thor in NVFP4, at 9.1x less energy and equal closed-loop success.
items.abstract_zh: GR00T 等视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过动作头控制机器人：动作头是一个扩散 Transformer，在少数 flow-matching 步内把噪声变成一段动作。每一步都要从 DRAM 重新读取动作头全部权重，而每个权重仅作用于约 50 个 token，因此推理受内存带宽限制，延迟与能耗主要由传输的权重比特总量决定。作者指出，后续流步会削弱前序步的量化误差，因此动作头的权重精度应随步数递增。仅用逐通道舍入、不做校准或训练，让位宽沿步数从 2 比特升至 4 比特，即可保持机器人策略的闭环成功率，且比每步都用 4 比特少传 25% 的比特。但现有的 Jetson AGX Thor GPU 内核因固定开销无法利用这种逐步精度。作者因此设计了一款可编程加速器，其延迟与能耗均随传输的权重比特数缩放：以 DRAM 速率对比特串行子阵列的熵编码权重解码；由于位宽逐步变化，运行时分配器在这些子阵列之间为线性层与注意力分配负载；同一批子阵列可运行不同家族与尺寸的动作头，乃至一个视觉语言模型。DRAM 侧每个 bank 配有重量化器与熵编码器，使一份存储的 8 比特副本可替代所有位宽的副本。按 LPDDR5X 时序进行 RTL 仿真，四个流步分别采用 2、3、3、4 比特时，GR00T N1.6 动作头每次推理耗时 8.02 ms；在每位宽各存一份副本、使用 Thor 50% 内存带宽的条件下，该加速器亦能运行这一调度。
items.highlight_zh: 动作头权重精度随流步由 2 比特升至 4 比特，少传 25% 比特
items.digest_zh:
· 研究问题：GR00T 这类 VLA 模型靠一个“动作头”控制机器人：动作头是扩散 Transformer，用少数 flow-matching 步把噪声变成一段动作。问题在于每走一步都要从 DRAM 把动作头全部权重读一遍，而每个权重只作用在约 50 个 token 上——推理严重受内存带宽限制，延迟与能耗基本由搬运的权重比特总数决定。
· 关键发现：作者观察到后序流步会“吸收”前序步的量化误差，所以权重精度不必每步相同，而应随步数递增。只用最朴素的逐通道舍入，既不校准也不训练，让位宽沿四个流步按 2、3、3、4 比特递增，机器人策略的闭环成功率即可保持；相比每步用 4 比特，少传 25% 的比特。但现有 GPU 内核（如 Jetson AGX Thor 上）存在固定开销，用不上这种逐步变化的精度。
· 硬件设计：作者实现了一款可编程加速器，延迟与能耗都随传输比特数缩放：以 DRAM 速率对比特串行子阵列做熵编码权重的解码；因位宽逐步变化，运行时分配器在线性层与注意力之间动态划分这些子阵列以平衡负载；同一批子阵列还能运行不同家族与尺寸的动作头，甚至一个视觉语言模型。DRAM 侧每个 bank 都放重量化器与熵编码器，使一份存储的 8 比特副本可替代所有位宽的多份副本。
· 结果与意义：按 LPDDR5X 时序做 RTL 仿真，四个流步分别用 2/3/3/4 比特，跑 GR00T N1.6 动作头每次推理 8.02 ms；在每位宽各存一份副本、使用 Thor 50% 内存带宽时也能运行该调度。意义在于把“算法层的逐步精度调度”与“硬件层的比特级可扩展”配对，绕开 GPU 固定开销这一瓶颈。

items.title_en: Syllable- and Word-Level Evaluation of Tibetan OCR
items.title_zh: 藏文 OCR 的音节级和词级评估
items.abstract_en: Optical character recognition (OCR) for Tibetan is evaluated predominantly by character error rate (CER). Tibetan marks syllable boundaries but does not mark word boundaries, so a word error rate requires a segmenter. This study evaluates nine recognizer configurations on typeset, woodblock and two handwritten script styles, alone and in combination, and reports syllable- and word-level error rates, to our knowledge the first for Tibetan OCR. The configurations span CTC models, TrOCR encoder-decoders with and without post-training quantization, and a vision-language model, and each is scored under CER, the syllable error rate (SER) and three segmented word error rates (SWER). CER ranks systems largely as the higher-level rates do (Kendall $τ\geq 0.833$), with one pair ordered oppositely. On the effect of joint training, CER and SER record significant changes of opposite sign in 7 of 64 comparisons. SER needs no segmenter and ranks systems as SWER does under two of the three segmenters ($τ\geq 0.889$). The output of each configuration is also tagged for part of speech, annotated for named entities and machine translated, and each result is compared with that obtained on the reference text. As rough guidance, translation chrF of 60 is reached at SER of 0.047 or below and part-of-speech preservation of 0.8 at 0.078 or below, while no error rate separates the systems that reach entity preservation of 0.6 from those that do not.
items.abstract_zh: 藏文的光学字符识别（OCR）主要按字符错误率（CER）评估。藏文标记音节边界但不标记词边界，因此词错误率需要分词器。本研究在排印、木刻和两种手写字体风格上，单独及组合评估九种识别器配置，并报告音节级和词级错误率；据我们所知，这是藏文 OCR 的首次。配置涵盖 CTC 模型、带和不带训练后量化的 TrOCR 编码器-解码器，以及一个视觉-语言模型，每种均在 CER、音节错误率（SER）和三种分词词错误率（SWER）下评分。CER 对系统的排序大体与更高级别错误率相同（Kendall τ≥0.833），仅有一对排序相反。关于联合训练的影响，在 64 次比较中有 7 次 CER 和 SER 记录到符号相反的显著变化。SER 无需分词器，且在三种分词器中的两种下，其系统排序与 SWER 相同（τ≥0.889）。每种配置的输出还被标注词性、标注命名实体并进行机器翻译，每个结果均与在参考文本上获得的结果进行比较。作为粗略指引，当 SER 为 0.047 或以下时翻译 chrF 达到 60，当 SER 为 0.078 或以下时词性保持率达到 0.8，而没有任何错误率能将达到 0.6 实体保持率的系统与未达到的系统区分开。

items.title_en: RoboMorpher: Scaling Robot Morphology Representations for Cross-Embodiment Action Prediction
items.title_zh: RoboMorpher：扩展机器人形态表示以实现跨具身动作预测
items.abstract_en: Learning shared action representations is central to cross-embodiment manipulation. However, identical joint values can produce different spatial configurations across robots, limiting representations learned from joint values alone. We introduce RoboMorpher, a morphology-conditioned action tokenizer that jointly reconstructs joint angles and link poses to associate control coordinates with their kinematic effects. MorphGen supplies scalable kinematic supervision by generating serial-arm descriptions from survey-derived geometric priors. We pretrain RoboMorpher on 40 million morphology-state pairs and integrate the frozen tokenizer into a vision-language-action policy for discrete prediction and continuous refinement. We also introduce EmbodiBench, a ten-task benchmark with 30 generated URDFs per task. With downstream URDFs excluded from tokenizer pretraining, the policy achieves 56.40% success on RoboTwin 2.0 and 23.27% on EmbodiBench, exceeding continuous joint-space control by 9.73 and 15.34 percentage points. Removing link-pose supervision reduces EmbodiBench success by 17.94 percentage points, supporting morphology-aware geometric supervision for joint-action representation learning.
items.abstract_zh: 学习共享动作表示是跨具身操作的核心。然而，相同的关节值在不同机器人上可能产生不同的空间构型，限制了仅从关节值学到的表示。我们提出 RoboMorpher，一种以形态为条件的动作分词器，它联合重建关节角和连杆位姿，以将控制坐标与其运动学效应关联起来。MorphGen 通过从调查推导的几何先验生成串联臂描述，提供可扩展的运动学监督。我们在 4000 万对形态-状态数据上预训练 RoboMorpher，并将冻结的分词器集成到视觉-语言-动作策略中，用于离散预测和连续细化。我们还推出 EmbodiBench，一个包含每任务 30 个生成 URDF 的十任务基准。在下游 URDF 被排除于分词器预训练的情况下，该策略在 RoboTwin 2.0 上达到 56.40% 成功率，在 EmbodiBench 上达到 23.27%，分别比连续关节空间控制高出 9.73 和 15.34 个百分点。移除连杆位姿监督会使 EmbodiBench 成功率降低 17.94 个百分点，支持对联合动作表示学习采用形态感知的几何监督。

items.title_en: NereidVLA: Learning to Understand and Navigate the Underwater World
items.title_zh: NereidVLA：学习理解与导航水下世界
items.abstract_en: Underwater navigation requires translating visual spatial cues into motion, yet marine vision-language datasets rarely include paired robot trajectories. We present NereidVLA, a vision-language-action model that transfers marine spatial knowledge to language-conditioned 3D navigation. We first train Sea2Know on approximately two million marine examples to learn target grounding, spatial relations, and scene structure without paired robot-motion supervision. We then adapt it using expert trajectories executed under simulated underwater vehicle dynamics. Given RGB histories and a language instruction, NereidVLA predicts discrete motion tokens that decode into local 3D trajectories for closed-loop tracking. Evaluation combines an independent six-dimensional underwater navigation understanding benchmark with offline prediction and closed-loop navigation. Under matched navigation training and execution settings, marine spatial pretraining increases simulation success from 72.4% to 84.4%. Without fine-tuning on the real test environment, NereidVLA achieves 78.75% success in laboratory-pool robot trials, compared with 47.50% for InternVLA-N1. These results show that marine spatial supervision can support downstream motion learning and physical underwater navigation.
items.abstract_zh: 水下导航需要将视觉空间线索转化为运动，然而海洋视觉-语言数据集很少包含配对的机器人轨迹。我们提出 NereidVLA，一种视觉-语言-动作模型，将海洋空间知识迁移到语言条件化的三维导航中。我们首先在大约两百万个海洋样本上训练 Sea2Know，以在无配对机器人运动监督的情况下学习目标定位、空间关系和场景结构。然后，我们使用在模拟水下航行器动力学下执行的专家轨迹对其适配。给定 RGB 历史观测和语言指令，NereidVLA 预测离散运动 token，这些 token 被解码为局部三维轨迹以进行闭环跟踪。评估结合了一个独立的六维水下导航理解基准，以及离线预测和闭环导航。在匹配的导航训练和执行设置下，海洋空间预训练将仿真成功率从 72.4% 提高到 84.4%。在未在真实测试环境中微调的情况下，NereidVLA 在实验室水池机器人试验中达到 78.75% 的成功率，而 InternVLA-N1 为 47.50%。这些结果表明，海洋空间监督可以支持下游运动学习和物理水下导航。

items.title_en: Inferring Neural Activity Changes under Recording Uncertainty with Transformers and Variational Inference
items.title_zh: 在记录不确定性下使用 Transformer 和变分推断推断神经活动变化
items.abstract_en: A difference in recorded firing rate across days may reflect a change in neuronal activity, missed spikes or recording a different neuron. We present a statistical approach that combines neuron tracking with Bayesian estimates of stationary mean recorded firing rates. Bounds under assumed differences in spike detection connect recorded rates to biological rate changes. We assess recording loss and uncertainty in rate changes in simulations, and count-model fit in recordings. We also compare two transformer estimators with Gaussian and flow variational inference under a shared temporal negative-binomial model. Flow variational inference agrees most closely with reference posteriors, while predictive performance varies across mice. Rate-change intervals contain true simulated changes less often than intended. In UnitMatch recordings from five mice, some inferred changes remain supported when spike detection is allowed to differ between days; others depend on equal detection. These interpretations require a correct neuron match. The approach identifies which inferred rate changes remain supported under specified recording assumptions and where uncertainty limits interpretation.
items.abstract_zh: 跨天记录的发放率差异可能反映神经活动变化、漏检的尖峰，或记录到了不同的神经元。我们提出一种统计方法，将神经元跟踪与对平稳平均记录发放率的贝叶斯估计相结合。在假设的尖峰检测差异下的边界将记录发放率与生物发放率变化联系起来。我们在仿真中评估记录损失和发放率变化的不确定性，并在记录中评估计数模型拟合。我们还在共享的时间负二项模型下，比较使用高斯变分推断和流变分推断的两种 Transformer 估计器。流变分推断与参考后验最接近，而预测性能在不同小鼠间存在差异。发放率变化区间包含真实模拟变化的频率低于预期。在来自五只小鼠的 UnitMatch 记录中，当允许不同天的尖峰检测存在差异时，一些推断出的变化仍然成立；另一些则依赖于检测相同。这些解释需要正确的神经元匹配。该方法识别出在指定记录假设下哪些推断出的发放率变化仍然成立，以及不确定性在何处限制了解释。

items.title_en: Optical Neural Networks Should Be Evaluated by Function, Not Only Physics
items.title_zh: 光学神经网络应按功能评估，而不仅是物理特性
items.abstract_en: Optical neural networks (ONNs) are attracting significant attention as alternative platforms for machine learning (ML). In an ONN, an optical module often takes over part of the computation inside a digital ML pipeline. How much of the task does the optical module itself perform, and how much does it contribute to any claimed system-level advantages, such as throughput or energy? This paper offers a simple, function-oriented evaluation methodology. Whatever its internal physics, the optical module appears to the surrounding digital pipeline as a mapping between real-valued tensors. We therefore evaluate it in three steps: (i) define its boundary in the pipeline, as real-valued tensors in and out; (ii) replace it with standard digital modules to identify those that match the optical system's performance on the same task and metric; and (iii) state system-level claims, such as speed or energy, per inference against the performance-matched digital module. We summarize steps (i) and (ii) in an Expressivity Card and demonstrate its use on published ONN systems. This helps isolate the optical module's contribution and provides a concrete digital reference for assessing its claimed system-level advantages, without the need to understand the physics. While we focus on optical systems as the most prominent example, the same approach applies to any physical analog computing platform used in ML, wherever a physical module takes over part of a digital pipeline.
items.abstract_zh: 光学神经网络（ONN）作为机器学习的替代平台正受到广泛关注。在 ONN 中，光学模块通常接管数字机器学习流水线中的部分计算。光学模块自身执行多少任务，以及它对所声称的系统级优势（如吞吐量或能耗）贡献多少？本文提供一种简单、面向功能的评估方法。无论其内部物理机制如何，光学模块对周围数字流水线而言表现为实值张量之间的映射。因此，我们分三步评估它：(i) 在流水线中定义其边界，即输入和输出的实值张量；(ii) 用标准数字模块替换它，以找出在同一任务和指标上与光学系统性能匹配的模块；(iii) 针对每次推理，相对于性能匹配的数字模块陈述系统级声明，如速度或能耗。我们将步骤 (i) 和 (ii) 总结为一张 Expressivity Card，并在已发表的 ONN 系统上演示其用法。这有助于分离光学模块的贡献，并为评估其所声称的系统级优势提供具体的数字参考，而无需理解物理机制。虽然我们聚焦于光学系统这一最突出的例子，但同样的方法适用于机器学习中使用的任何物理模拟计算平台，只要物理模块接管了数字流水线的一部分。

items.title_en: Continual Tool-Space Extension Learning for Multimodal Agents
items.title_zh: 面向多模态智能体的持续工具空间扩展学习
items.abstract_en: Multimodal agents largely rely on generic tools such as cropping, search, and code execution, leaving specialist vision models outside their tool space. However, bringing such a model into an already trained agent is not straightforward. The challenge is to learn each new tool efficiently while retaining the ability to use existing ones. This work proposes COTEX, continual tool-space extension learning, that adds new tools at efficient adapter-level cost. COTEX locates two sets of parameter directions; one triggers a tool call and thereby opens a multi-turn reasoning trajectory, while the other determines which tool is chosen. The adapter of a new tool is restricted to the calling directions that leave earlier tool choices unaffected by orthogonal constraint. We further introduce a protocol that converts specialist models' existing task-specific annotations into verified tool-use trajectories. Experiments on two representative agents and three specialist tools show gains on ten vision-language benchmarks, with at most a 0.3-point drop on existing tools.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态智能体主要依赖裁剪、搜索和代码执行等通用工具，使专用视觉模型处于其工具空间之外。然而，将此类模型引入已训练的智能体并非易事。挑战在于高效学习每个新工具，同时保留使用现有工具的能力。本工作提出 COTEX，即持续工具空间扩展学习，以高效的适配器级成本添加新工具。COTEX 定位两组参数方向；一组触发工具调用，从而开启多轮推理轨迹，另一组决定选择哪个工具。新工具的适配器被限制在调用方向上，并通过正交约束使先前的工具选择不受影响。我们进一步引入一种协议，将专用模型现有的任务特定标注转换为经过验证的工具使用轨迹。在两个代表性智能体和三种专用工具上的实验表明，在十个视觉-语言基准上取得提升，同时在现有工具上最多下降 0.3 个百分点。

items.title_en: Thinking Harder Doesn't Lead to Better Choices: Reasoning Effort Increases the Confidence but Not the Correctness of LLM Shopping Agents
items.title_zh: 想得更久并不能带来更好的选择：推理努力提高了 LLM 购物智能体的置信度，但未提高其正确性
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous shopping agents that process multimodal product listings (consisting of visual and text data) and recommend purchases on behalf of consumers. Naturally, one might assume that models with more thinking power would make higher-quality purchasing decisions. To test this belief, we ask two questions about such agents: does asking a model to think harder make it choose better products, and does the confidence it reports tell us the likelihood it may be wrong? We benchmark ten frontier models on three product-choice benchmarks built from WebShop, Amazon's SQID and Wayfair's WANDS platforms to see if LLMs with more thinking power actually make better-quality product purchase decisions. Across all three benchmarks, we found that increasing the thinking effort does not increase decision quality in a statistically meaningful way. The same change in thinking effort raises stated confidence at a statistically significant level, so extra thinking buys confidence rather than correctness. We also measure the calibration of these models (how well their reported confidence percentage matches their true correctness percentage) in these tasks and show that most models are not well-calibrated at every effort level. We also find that errors are strongly shared: when one model errs in a task, several others tend to err on that same task. Furthermore, on tasks where several models all err, a large number of them pick the same wrong product.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被部署为自主购物智能体，它们处理多模态商品列表（由视觉和文本数据组成），并代表消费者推荐购买。人们自然会假设，具有更强思考能力的模型会做出更高质量的购买决策。为检验这一信念，我们针对此类智能体提出两个问题：要求模型更努力思考是否会让它选择更好的产品，以及它报告的置信度是否能告诉我们它可能出错的可能性？我们在由 WebShop、亚马逊的 SQID 和 Wayfair 的 WANDS 平台构建的三个产品选择基准上对十个前沿模型进行基准测试，以检验具有更强思考能力的 LLM 是否确实做出更高质量的产品购买决策。在所有三个基准上，我们发现增加思考努力并不会以统计显著的方式提高决策质量。同样的思考努力变化以统计显著水平提高了所声明的置信度，因此额外的思考换来的是置信度而非正确性。我们还测量了这些模型在这些任务中的校准性（其报告的置信度百分比与真实正确率百分比的匹配程度），并表明大多数模型并非在每个努力水平上都校准良好。我们还发现错误具有强共享性：当一个模型在某任务上出错时，其他几个模型也往往在同一任务上出错。此外，在多个模型都出错的任务上，其中很大一部分选择了相同的错误产品。

items.title_en: SHAPE: Discrete Supervision and Parallel Continuous Streams for Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Human Data
items.title_zh: SHAPE：用于从第一人称人类数据学习灵巧操作的离散监督与并行连续流
items.abstract_en: Egocentric human recordings are far cheaper than dexterous robot demonstrations, promising stronger pretraining and direct skill learning without task-specific robot data. Yet humans and robots differ in morphology and kinematics, so human recordings lack the joint positions and actuator commands that supervise robot policies, providing only retargeted end-effector (EEF) actions. This raises two questions: how human data should supervise the policy, and how a dexterous robot should read out actions at deployment. We address both in SHAPE (Supervision from Human Action tokens with Parallel Executable streams), a vision-language-action (VLA) model whose backbone predicts discrete action tokens of EEF chunks as an auxiliary task, while a shared flow-matching expert outputs two executable streams, EEF and joint. On a bimanual robot with 22-DoF hands, a matched study shows that discrete supervision helps learn from human data, driving backbone gradients and shaping action-informative representations across domains. Under standard control pipelines at deployment, direct joint readout excels at fine-grained control with robot demonstrations, scoring 0.80 across six tasks against 0.63 for π0.5, whereas IK-based EEF readout excels at human-to-robot transfer. Pretrained with human data and discrete tokens, SHAPE learns new tasks from human demonstrations without task-specific robot data.
items.abstract_zh: 第一人称人类记录远比灵巧机器人演示便宜，有望在无需任务特定机器人数据的情况下实现更强的预训练和直接技能学习。然而，人类和机器人在形态和运动学上存在差异，因此人类记录缺少监督机器人策略所需的关节位置和执行器指令，仅提供重定向后的末端执行器（EEF）动作。这引出两个问题：人类数据应如何监督策略，以及灵巧机器人在部署时应如何读出动作。我们在 SHAPE（Supervision from Human Action tokens with Parallel Executable streams）中解决这两个问题。SHAPE 是一种视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，其主干作为辅助任务预测 EEF 片段的离散动作 token，而共享的流匹配专家输出两个可执行流：EEF 和关节。在一台配备 22 自由度手的双臂机器人上，一项匹配研究表明，离散监督有助于从人类数据中学习，驱动主干梯度并在跨域中塑造具有动作信息性的表示。在部署时的标准控制流水线下，直接关节读出在使用机器人演示进行细粒度控制方面表现出色，在六项任务上得分为 0.80，而 π0.5 为 0.63；而基于 IK 的 EEF 读出则在人到机器人迁移方面表现出色。使用人类数据和离散 token 预训练后，SHAPE 可从人类演示中学习新任务，而无需任务特定的机器人数据。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: PatchAdaNet: Unsupervised class incremental learning using local patches and global adapters
items.title_zh: PatchAdaNet：使用局部图像块和全局适配器的无监督类增量学习
items.abstract_en: Biological learning systems acquire knowledge incrementally through broad, reusable representations established early and kept largely stable, while integrating new experience with minimal interference with previously learned knowledge. Replay-based methods approximate this by storing samples or features from previous tasks and mixing them into the current task. However, memory buffers grow with the number of tasks and may retain task-specific noise that reduces generalization. To address these limitations, we propose PatchAdaNet (Patch Adapter Network), an unsupervised class-incremental learning method for image classification that continually updates feature representations using autoencoders. Since images share structural features such as edges, corners, and shapes, we first divide each image into patches and train independent autoencoders on external data to reconstruct each patch. The layers of all patch encoders are aggregated into global frozen layers that generalize across tasks and remain fixed throughout learning. Learnable adapters then build global image representations from these features to reconstruct the entire image. To prevent feature drift without storing data, we introduce the Global Feature Centroid (GFC), a fixed-size running average of adapter outputs updated after each task to penalizes representation drift. Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) is applied to the learnable layers to preserve previously learned features by constraining important weights. Finally, a linear classifier is trained on the frozen latent representation and GFC for class-incremental evaluation. We evaluate PatchAdaNet in both CNN and Vision Transformer settings on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, miniImageNet and 5-Datasets, providing a comparative study of the two architectures under identical class-incremental settings. Code is available.
items.abstract_zh: 生物学习系统通过早期建立并基本保持稳定的大范围可复用表征来增量获取知识，同时以对先前所学知识的最小干扰整合新经验。基于回放的方法通过存储先前任务的样本或特征并将其混入当前任务来近似这一过程。然而，记忆缓冲区会随任务数量增长，并可能保留降低泛化的任务特定噪声。为解决这些限制，我们提出PatchAdaNet（Patch Adapter Network），一种用于图像分类的无监督类增量学习方法，使用自编码器持续更新特征表示。由于图像共享边缘、角和形状等结构特征，我们首先将每幅图像划分为图像块，并在外部数据上训练独立自编码器以重建每个图像块。所有图像块编码器的层被聚合为全局冻结层，这些层可跨任务泛化并在整个学习过程中保持固定。随后，可学习适配器从这些特征构建全局图像表示以重建整幅图像。为在不存储数据的情况下防止特征漂移，我们引入全局特征质心（Global Feature Centroid, GFC），它是适配器输出的固定大小滑动平均，在每个任务后更新，以惩罚表示漂移。对可学习层应用弹性权重巩固（Elastic Weight Consolidation, EWC），通过约束重要权重来保留先前学到的特征。最后，在冻结的潜在表示和GFC上训练线性分类器，用于类增量评估。我们在CNN和Vision Transformer两种设置下，在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、miniImageNet和5-Datasets上评估PatchAdaNet，并在相同类增量设置下对两种架构进行比较研究。代码已公开。
