items.title_en: HoloGene: Learning to Lift Sliced Spatial Transcriptomics to Holistic 3D Gene Fields
items.title_zh: HoloGene：学习将切片空间转录组学提升为整体三维基因场
items.abstract_en: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) provides spatially resolved gene expression measurements, but most 3D ST datasets are acquired as independently processed 2D sections. Computational approaches span slice registration and integration, explicit or generative interpolation, and coordinate-field modeling. Within the last family, implicit neural representations (INRs) offer a continuous, coordinate-queryable parameterization, but standard isotropic coordinate encodings do not explicitly reflect that serial-section measurements are dense in-plane and sparse along the axial direction. We present HoloGene, an anisotropic conditional INR framework for estimating continuous 3D gene-expression fields from pre-registered ST sections. Its central contribution is an acquisition-aware factorization that couples dense in-plane synthesis with sparse axial evolution using established GAE, FiLM, pseudo-label supervision, and CORAL components. HoloGene compresses high-dimensional expression profiles into a graph-autoencoder latent manifold, uses pseudo-label-derived signature conditioning to provide coarse intra-section context, and applies depth-dependent FiLM modulation to model axial variation. A signature-stratified correlation-alignment regularizer encourages cross-slice covariance alignment in latent features. Using held-out measured sections as cross-sectional references, HoloGene improves reconstruction accuracy and biological preservation metrics compared with general-purpose INRs and adapted spatial-transcriptomics baselines. These results support anisotropic conditional modeling as a practical strategy for estimating 3D expression fields from discontinuous ST sections. Code is available at https://github.com/Szym29/HoloGene.
items.abstract_zh: 空间转录组学（ST）提供空间分辨的基因表达测量，但大多数 3D ST 数据集是作为独立处理的 2D 切片获取的。计算方法涵盖切片配准与整合、显式或生成式插值，以及坐标场建模。在最后一类中，隐式神经表示（INRs）提供连续、可坐标查询的参数化，但标准的各向同性坐标编码并未明确反映连续切片测量在面内密集而沿轴向稀疏。我们提出 HoloGene，一个各向异性条件 INR 框架，用于从预配准的 ST 切片估计连续 3D 基因表达场。其核心贡献是一种采集感知的因子分解，使用已有的 GAE、FiLM、伪标签监督和 CORAL 组件，将密集面内合成与稀疏轴向演化耦合起来。HoloGene 将高维表达谱压缩到图自编码器潜在流形中，使用由伪标签导出的签名条件化提供粗略的切片内上下文，并应用深度相关的 FiLM 调制来建模轴向变化。按签名分层的相关性对齐正则化器鼓励潜在特征中的跨切片协方差对齐。使用留出的实测切片作为横截面参考，与通用 INRs 和适配的空间转录组学基线相比，HoloGene 提高了重建准确率和生物保留指标。这些结果支持将各向异性条件建模作为从离散 ST 切片估计 3D 表达场的一种实用策略。代码可在 https://github.com/Szym29/HoloGene 获取。

items.title_en: What Majority Labels Hide: Annotator Disagreement and Model Errors in Multi-Dialect Arabic Sexism Detection
items.title_zh: 多数标签掩盖了什么：多方言阿拉伯语性别歧视检测中的标注者分歧与模型错误
items.abstract_en: Judgements of sexism are subjective and may vary across communities, yet sexism detection datasets usually reduce annotator judgements to a single majority label, obscuring disagreement and how models behave on contested cases. We introduce MuDAS, a dataset of YouTube comments in Saudi, Egyptian and Moroccan Arabic, each labelled by three native speakers of its dialect, with the individual annotations preserved. We use it to evaluate Arabic encoders fine-tuned with hard-label, soft-label and perspectivist objectives, GPT-5.6 Terra, and four Arabic-centric large language models. Model errors are more frequent on comments with annotator disagreement. Despite relatively close Macro-F1 scores, GPT-5.6 Terra and the fine-tuned encoders exhibit contrasting error patterns: GPT-5.6 Terra, even with the annotators' definition of sexism, over-classifies gender-related content such as religious advice on modesty, whereas the encoders miss implicit and prescriptive sexism. The Arabic-centric models also over-predict sexism and remain below the encoders. Disagreement-aware learning preserves Macro-F1, but soft labels improve alignment with annotators on contested comments at the expense of unanimous ones, and neither paradigm reliably identifies contested comments. Lower performance on Egyptian Arabic, clearest for the large language models, is not fully explained by the examined measures of test-set composition and dialectness. Majority-label scores can therefore hide contrasting error patterns that matter for content moderation.
items.abstract_zh: 对性别歧视的判断是主观的，可能因社区而异，但性别歧视检测数据集通常将标注者判断简化为单一多数标签，从而掩盖了分歧以及模型在有争议案例上的行为。我们引入 MuDAS，这是一个包含沙特、埃及和摩洛哥阿拉伯语 YouTube 评论的数据集，每条评论由其方言的三名母语者标注，并保留个体标注。我们使用它来评估以硬标签、软标签和视角主义目标微调的阿拉伯语编码器、GPT-5.6 Terra，以及四个以阿拉伯语为中心的大语言模型。模型错误在存在标注者分歧的评论上更频繁。尽管 Macro-F1 分数相对接近，GPT-5.6 Terra 和微调编码器表现出对比鲜明的错误模式：GPT-5.6 Terra 即使采用标注者的性别歧视定义，也会过度分类与性别相关的内容，例如关于谦逊的宗教建议，而编码器则漏掉隐性和规定性性别歧视。以阿拉伯语为中心的模型也过度预测性别歧视，并且仍低于编码器。分歧感知学习保持了 Macro-F1，但软标签以牺牲一致评论为代价，提高了在有争议评论上与标注者的一致性，而且两种范式都不能可靠地识别有争议评论。埃及阿拉伯语上较低的性能（在大语言模型中最为明显）不能完全由所考察的测试集构成和方言性度量来解释。因此，多数标签分数可能掩盖对内容审核至关重要的对比性错误模式。

items.title_en: Learning to Interact in Multi-Agent Self-Play for Controllable Autonomous Driving Scenario Generation
items.title_zh: 在多智能体自博弈中学习交互以可控地生成自动驾驶场景
items.abstract_en: Large-scale, multi-agent self-play trains robust driving policies effectively in simulation, but controlling these models to generate specific, safety-critical edge cases remains a key challenge. Existing goal-conditioned self-play frameworks rely primarily on static map-location goals and fail to reliably produce complex agent interactions such as aggressive tailgating or adversarial cut-offs. These agent interactions are necessary for rigorous autonomous vehicle (AV) testing. To address this, we present an extended multi-agent self-play framework that introduces agent-relative dynamic goals. By conditioning policies on this extended goal representation, our framework enables targeted, controllable scenario synthesis. We demonstrate that our approach successfully generates interactive driving behaviors that static-goal baselines cannot simulate, providing a flexible tool for long-tail scenario generation in AV testing.
items.abstract_zh: 大规模、多智能体自博弈在仿真中有效训练了稳健的驾驶策略，但控制这些模型生成特定的安全关键边缘案例仍然是一个关键挑战。现有的目标条件自博弈框架主要依赖静态地图位置目标，无法可靠地产生复杂的智能体交互，例如激进尾随或对抗性切入。这些智能体交互对于严格的自动驾驶车辆（AV）测试是必要的。为解决这一问题，我们提出一个扩展的多智能体自博弈框架，引入智能体相对动态目标。通过以这种扩展目标表示作为策略条件，我们的框架能够进行有针对性的、可控的场景合成。我们证明，我们的方法成功生成了静态目标基线无法模拟的交互式驾驶行为，为 AV 测试中的长尾场景生成提供了灵活工具。

items.title_en: StrideWorld: Benchmarking Scene Rigidity and Action Consistency in Interactive Video World Model
items.title_zh: StrideWorld：对交互式视频世界模型中的场景刚性与动作一致性进行基准测试
items.abstract_en: Interactive video world models turn user commands into the exploration of a generated scene, which requires the scene to keep its 3D structure as the camera moves and each action to keep a stable effect. Existing benchmarks mostly evaluate these properties against references fitted to the video under test, either a scene reconstructed from its own frames or a camera trajectory aligned to the command path with a free scale. Such references can absorb gradual scene deformation and changes in pace and route length, so these errors can pass undetected. We therefore introduce StrideWorld, a benchmark whose references are fixed before the motion they judge. It evaluates scene rigidity against the ground-truth geometry of the start view, and action consistency against the stride of each action, the camera motion of one command. The stride is measured on the model's first steps and then used to test the steps that follow, so each model is judged only against its own steps. Its measurements are validated on rendered videos with known camera motion, and its scores agree with human judgments. Across \nvideos{} videos generated by \nmodels{} open models from $140$ start views, all models but one deform their scenes as the camera moves, with offsets up to $7.3$ times those of a rigid rendering along the same camera path. Most models keep a steady pace when a single action is held. Along composed routes, several models often stall, and most completed routes end away from the positions predicted by each model's own strides. Only the two models that scale commands by the estimated scene depth bring most routes close to these positions. Fine-tuning two models on a few rendered clips removes most of their mid-route stalls. Code, data, and a leaderboard are publicly available at https://github.com/chuangwang123/strideworld.
items.abstract_zh: 交互式视频世界模型将用户命令转化为对生成场景的探索，这要求场景在相机移动时保持其三维结构，并且每个动作保持稳定的效果。现有基准大多针对与被测视频拟合得到的参考来评估这些性质，这些参考要么是从视频自身帧重建的场景，要么是以自由尺度对齐到命令路径的相机轨迹。此类参考会吸收渐进的场景形变以及节奏和路线长度的变化，因此这些误差可能未被发现。因此，我们提出 StrideWorld，其参考在被评判的运动之前就已固定。它依据起始视角的真值几何来评估场景刚性，并依据每个动作的步幅（即一条命令对应的相机运动）来评估动作一致性。步幅在模型的最初若干步上测量，然后用于检验后续步骤，因此每个模型仅依据其自身步幅被评判。其测量在具有已知相机运动的渲染视频上得到验证，其分数与人类判断一致。在由 \nvideos{} 个视频组成、由 \nmodels{} 个开源模型从 140 个起始视角生成的结果中，除一个模型外，所有模型都会在相机移动时使其场景发生形变，偏移最高达到沿同一相机路径的刚性渲染的 7.3 倍。大多数模型在保持单一动作时能维持稳定节奏。沿组合路线时，若干模型经常停滞，而且大多数完成的路线终止于偏离各模型自身步幅所预测位置的地方。只有两个按估计场景深度缩放命令的模型使大多数路线接近这些位置。在少量渲染片段上微调两个模型可消除其中途停滞的大部分情况。代码、数据和排行榜已在 https://github.com/chuangwang123/strideworld 公开。

items.title_en: AMBER: mapping accessible chromatin associations through barcode seed expansion
items.title_zh: AMBER：通过条形码种子扩展映射可及染色质关联
items.abstract_en: Accessible chromatin establishes higher-order regulatory structures spanning multiple spatial scales. We developed AMBER, a hydrogel-assisted approach for confined expansion of barcode seeds and subsequent recording of accessible chromatin associations. In mouse brain cells, we characterized the multi-scale regulatory organizations that accessibility alone cannot explain. We identified a subset of genomic regions enriched for inter-chromosomal interactions that also encode proteins engaged in interaction networks. These regulatory hubs are essential for neural function and help predict disease-risk loci and regulators.
items.abstract_zh: 可及染色质建立了跨越多个空间尺度的高阶调控结构。我们开发了 AMBER，一种水凝胶辅助方法，用于条形码种子的受限扩展并随后记录可及染色质关联。在小鼠脑细胞中，我们表征了仅靠可及性无法解释的多尺度调控组织。我们识别出一部分基因组区域，这些区域富集染色体间相互作用，同时也编码参与相互作用网络的蛋白质。这些调控枢纽对神经功能至关重要，并有助于预测疾病风险位点和调控因子。

items.title_en: Squeezed Cooling and Lasing with Cold Atoms in Cavity-QED
items.title_zh: 腔QED中利用冷原子的压缩冷却与激射
items.abstract_en: A squeezed laser undergoes a lasing transition into a squeezed cavity mode, where stimulated emission generates a bright coherent field with a laser-like coherence time while maintaining one field quadrature below the vacuum noise level. Here we propose an optical implementation that needs neither a nonlinear crystal nor injected squeezed light, based on engineered interactions between ensembles of rubidium atoms and a squeezed cavity mode via cavity-assisted Raman transitions. A first ensemble cools the cavity into a squeezed vacuum, a mechanism we term squeezed cooling, yielding up to 9 dB in the intracavity field, surpassing the 3 dB limit of optical parametric oscillators. Tuned for output instead, it reaches up to 18 dB of output squeezing. Incoherently pumping a second ensemble drives a lasing transition into the squeezed mode, emitting a bright beam with long coherence time and noise below vacuum spanning a megahertz-wide band, away from the sharp phase-diffusion peak of excess noise at the carrier frequency, and robust to relaxation oscillations. We characterize lasing thresholds, superradiant emission, and linewidth narrowing, and identify the experimentally accessible regime where the system exhibits the defining features of a squeezed laser.
items.abstract_zh: 压缩激光会经历向压缩腔模的激射跃迁，其中受激辐射产生具有类激光相干时间的明亮相干场，同时保持一个场正交分量低于真空噪声水平。在这里，我们提出一种光学实现，既不需要非线性晶体，也不需要注入压缩光，其基于通过腔辅助拉曼跃迁在铷原子系综与压缩腔模之间工程化的相互作用。第一个系综将腔冷却为压缩真空，我们将这一机制称为压缩冷却，在腔内场中获得高达 9 dB 的压缩，超过光学参量振荡器的 3 dB 极限。若转而针对输出进行调谐，则可达到高达 18 dB 的输出压缩。对第二个系综进行非相干泵浦会驱动向压缩模的激射跃迁，发射出具有长相干时间且噪声低于真空的明亮光束，其覆盖兆赫兹宽频带，远离载波频率处过剩噪声的尖锐相位扩散峰，并且对弛豫振荡稳健。我们表征了激射阈值、超辐射发射和线宽窄化，并确定了系统表现出压缩激光定义性特征的实验可及区域。

items.title_en: Elysium: Simulation-Free Unbalanced Schrödinger Bridges
items.title_zh: Elysium：免模拟的非平衡薛定谔桥
items.abstract_en: Reconstructing cellular dynamics from snapshots is challenging because the destructive nature of single-cell measurements makes tracking the same cells over time impossible. Cellular dynamics are inherently stochastic and involve changes in population size through proliferation and apoptosis. Growth-based methods represent population change as a rate on the density, which does not assign exits and entries to individual cells. Unbalanced Schrödinger bridges model individual events, but neural solvers for killed diffusion bridges simulate trajectories during training. We introduce Elysium, a simulation-free solver that jointly learns state transition and mass change. Using a killed Brownian reference and its time reversal, Elysium constructs direct regression objectives from an optimal endpoint coupling and conditional bridge distributions, without simulating trajectories during training. We show that the minimizers of the expected training objectives recover the optimal unbalanced Schrödinger bridge. Empirically, Elysium reconstructs state transitions, population size, and event distributions on simulated benchmarks with known killed-diffusion ground truth, outperforming existing deterministic and bridge-based solvers. On single-cell time courses, it interpolates cell state distributions at unobserved time points, tracks population expansion and contraction, and captures biphasic drug-response dynamics.
items.abstract_zh: 从快照重建细胞动力学具有挑战性，因为单细胞测量的破坏性使得无法随时间追踪同一细胞。细胞动力学本质上是随机的，并通过增殖和凋亡涉及种群大小的变化。基于增长的方法将种群变化表示为密度上的速率，这不会将退出和进入分配给单个细胞。非平衡薛定谔桥对单个事件建模，但用于杀死扩散桥的神经求解器会在训练期间模拟轨迹。我们提出 Elysium，一种免模拟求解器，联合学习状态转移和质量变化。利用杀死布朗参考及其时间反转，Elysium 从最优端点耦合和条件桥分布构造直接回归目标，而无需在训练期间模拟轨迹。我们证明，期望训练目标的极小值点可恢复最优非平衡薛定谔桥。在经验上，Elysium 在具有已知杀死扩散真值的模拟基准上重建状态转移、种群大小和事件分布，优于现有的确定性求解器和基于桥的求解器。在单细胞时间进程上，它插值未观测时间点的细胞状态分布，追踪种群扩张和收缩，并捕捉双相药物响应动力学。

items.title_en: A Mechanistic Analysis of In-Context Learning and Out-of-Context Hallucination
items.title_zh: 上下文学习与上下文外幻觉的机制分析
items.abstract_en: Large language models can infer and follow specific rules through in-context learning (ICL), yet may fail to remain faithful to provided evidence, giving rise to out-of-context (OOC) hallucination. Existing work has largely investigated the underlying mechanisms of ICL and OOC hallucination along separate lines. However, this separation obscures the mechanistic basis for these seemingly opposing outcomes. In this work, we study this contrast through the unified view of functional roles in dynamic context. The key observation is that role information can be internally represented without reliably constraining output. We derive a first-order decomposition to characterize the role effect, showing that its substantial influence depends on two necessary conditions, namely sufficient contribution magnitude and coherent signed aggregation. Causal analysis further shows that role span contributions affect key token choices involving response structure, content selection, and factual values. We further show that role-consistent choices depend on sufficient role span support at these key decisions, while failing choices can be reversed when this support overcomes the deficit. These findings support a common mechanistic view of ICL and OOC hallucination: each functional role defines the pattern of output decisions over which role span contributions must remain effective, and differences in this organization account for the seemingly opposing outcomes.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型可以通过上下文学习（ICL）推断并遵循特定规则，但可能无法忠实于所提供的证据，从而产生上下文外（OOC）幻觉。现有工作大多沿各自独立的路线研究 ICL 和 OOC 幻觉的潜在机制。然而，这种分离掩盖了这些看似相反结果背后的机制基础。在本工作中，我们通过动态上下文中功能角色的统一视角来研究这一对比。关键观察是，角色信息可以在内部被表示，却不能可靠地约束输出。我们推导出一阶分解来刻画角色效应，表明其显著影响取决于两个必要条件，即足够的贡献幅度和一致的带符号聚合。因果分析进一步表明，角色片段贡献会影响涉及响应结构、内容选择和事实值的关键 token 选择。我们进一步表明，角色一致的选择取决于这些关键决策处足够的角色片段支持，而当这种支持克服不足时，失败的选择可以被逆转。这些发现支持关于 ICL 和 OOC 幻觉的共同机制观点：每个功能角色定义了输出决策的模式，角色片段贡献必须在该模式上保持有效，而这种组织方式的差异解释了看似相反的结果。

items.title_en: Attention Is Not Relevance: Challenging the Causality of Attention in Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: 注意力并非相关性：挑战自动驾驶中注意力的因果性
items.abstract_en: Attention has become one of the most widely adopted solutions for estimating the relevance of surrounding objects and interpreting an autonomous vehicle's driving decisions. However, its ability to capture the causal impact of individual input elements on an AI model's output has long been discussed in the literature, particularly in the Natural Language Processing (NLP) domain. This work brings this discussion into the autonomous driving domain by analyzing the accuracy of attention in estimating the impact of an input object on an autonomous vehicle's driving, i.e., its relevance. To this end, we compare different attention-based relevance estimation methods against a causal reference of object relevance obtained through counterfactual analysis. We perform our analysis on more than 80,000 synthetic driving scenes using an autonomous vehicle based on PlanT 2.0, a state-of-the-art Transformer-based model for object-level planning. Results show that attention provides a correlational rather than causal indication of object relevance. Attention-based relevance estimation methods do not consistently identify all relevant objects and tend to incorrectly classify as relevant objects with little or no impact on the vehicle's driving. In particular, results show that attention can effectively identify relevant objects in simple single-lane, straight-road scenarios, but its accuracy degrades in more complex settings, such as multi-lane roads and intersections. These findings highlight the limitations of attention as a proxy for object relevance, calling for novel methods able to accurately capture the causal impact of individual objects on the vehicle's driving and distinguish it from correlational associations.
items.abstract_zh: 注意力已成为估计周围物体相关性并解释自动驾驶车辆驾驶决策的最广泛采用的解决方案之一。然而，其捕捉单个输入元素对 AI 模型输出的因果影响的能力长期以来在文献中受到讨论，尤其是在自然语言处理（NLP）领域。本工作通过分析注意力在估计输入物体对自动驾驶车辆驾驶影响（即其相关性）方面的准确性，将这一讨论引入自动驾驶领域。为此，我们将不同的基于注意力的相关性估计方法与通过反事实分析获得的物体相关性因果参考进行比较。我们使用基于 PlanT 2.0（一种用于对象级规划的最先进 Transformer 模型）的自动驾驶车辆，在超过 80,000 个合成驾驶场景上进行分析。结果表明，注意力提供的是物体相关性的相关性指示而非因果指示。基于注意力的相关性估计方法不能一致地识别所有相关物体，并且倾向于将对该车辆驾驶影响很小或没有影响的物体错误分类为相关。特别是，结果表明注意力可以在简单的单车道直路场景中有效识别相关物体，但在更复杂的环境中（如多车道道路和交叉路口）其准确性会下降。这些发现凸显了注意力作为物体相关性代理的局限性，并呼吁能够准确捕捉单个物体对车辆驾驶的因果影响并将其与相关性关联区分开来的新方法。

items.title_en: Unmyelinated axons alter the biological interpretation of MRI biomarkers of demyelination
items.title_zh: 无髓鞘轴突改变脱髓鞘MRI生物标志物的生物学解释
items.abstract_en: Quantitative MRI methods are widely used to probe white matter microstructure; yet diffusion- and relaxation-based metrics are often interpreted primarily in terms of myelinated axons, implicitly assuming a negligible contribution from unmyelinated axons. Here, combining diffusion MRI (dMRI), relaxation-based MRI, and electron microscopy (EM) in the cuprizone mouse model of demyelination and recovery, we examine how unmyelinated axons shape MRI-derived microstructural indices, including axonal water fraction and $g$-ratio. To enable quantitative cellular-level comparisons, we developed automated tools for instance-level EM segmentation of white matter, allowing morphological analysis of myelinated and unmyelinated axonal populations. We find that, in the mouse model, diffusion-derived estimates of axonal water fraction reflect contributions from both axonal populations at sufficiently short diffusion times; accounting for unmyelinated axons removes an apparent bias and reveals that this metric corresponds to the total intra-axonal space rather than myelinated fibers alone. Similarly, MRI-derived $g$-ratio estimates correlate strongly with EM only when both axonal populations are included. We further demonstrate that within-voxel $g$-ratio heterogeneity introduces a systematic negative bias of up to $8\%$, increasing with the fraction of unmyelinated axons and variability in myelin thickness. Together, these findings change the biological interpretation of MRI biomarkers during demyelination by demonstrating that unmyelinated axons are a major determinant of MRI-derived white matter indices and that combining diffusion and relaxation contrasts enables a more accurate and interpretable quantification of demyelination. They further highlight the need for quantitative biomarkers that account for axonal heterogeneity in both health and disease.
items.abstract_zh: 定量MRI方法被广泛用于探测白质微结构；然而，基于扩散和弛豫的指标常主要依据髓鞘化轴突来解释，隐含假设无髓鞘轴突的贡献可忽略。在此，我们在cuprizone脱髓鞘与恢复小鼠模型中结合扩散MRI（dMRI）、基于弛豫的MRI和电子显微镜（EM），考察无髓鞘轴突如何塑造MRI衍生的微结构指标，包括轴突水分数和g-ratio。为实现定量细胞水平比较，我们开发了用于白质实例级EM分割的自动化工具，从而可对髓鞘化和无髓鞘轴突群体进行形态学分析。我们发现，在该小鼠模型中，在足够短的扩散时间下，扩散衍生的轴突水分数估计反映两个轴突群体的贡献；将无髓鞘轴突纳入考虑可消除表观偏倚，并揭示该指标对应总轴内空间而非仅髓鞘化纤维。类似地，MRI衍生的g-ratio估计仅在纳入两个轴突群体时才与EM强相关。我们进一步证明，体素内g-ratio异质性引入最高达8%的系统性负偏倚，并随无髓鞘轴突比例和髓鞘厚度变异性的增加而增大。总之，这些发现通过证明无髓鞘轴突是MRI衍生白质指标的主要决定因素，以及结合扩散与弛豫对比能够更准确、更可解释地量化脱髓鞘，改变了脱髓鞘期间MRI生物标志物的生物学解释。它们进一步强调需要能够考虑健康和疾病中轴突异质性的定量生物标志物。

items.title_en: Apples-to-apples transcriptomics: a parent-of-origin-resolved 'Granny Smith' genome reveals how reference choice shapes biological interpretation
items.title_zh: 对等比较的转录组学：亲本来源解析的‘Granny Smith’基因组揭示参考选择如何塑造生物学解释
items.abstract_en: The accuracy and reliability of RNA-seqbased transcriptome profiling inherently depends on how well the reference genome represents the genotype being studied, particularly in highly heterozygous, clonally propagated crops with many genetically distinct cultivars, such as apple. Here, we present a chromosome-scale, parent-of-origin-resolved genome assembly and highly complete annotation for Granny Smith (assembly BUSCO = 98.6% both haplotypes; annotation BUSCO = 98.7-98.9%). To test how reference genome choice influences transcriptomic interpretation, we mapped RNA-seq data from sun- and shade-exposed Granny Smith peel independently to three different apple genome references: GDDH13 (earlier-generation), WA 38 (modern-generation), and both Granny Smith haplotypes (modern and cultivar matched). Despite small difference in unique mapping rate, transcriptome analysis using the modern references showed greater agreement in differentially expressed gene families than GDDH13, while the cultivar-matched Granny Smith references recovered additional functional responses associated with oxidative stress, cuticle biology, and other processes relevant to sun exposure and cold storage. Importantly, many responses were consistent with previously identified metabolomic patterns from the same experimental material, providing independent biological support for signals recovered with the matched reference. Reference-dependent differences were greatest for the subtle sun-exposure storage interaction, indicating reference limitations become more consequential as biological contrasts become finer. Orthogroup-based analyses further showed that both reference-generation differences and paralog representation contribute to cross-genome disagreement. Together, these results demonstrate that seemingly modest differences in mapping performance can substantially alter biological conclusions and highlight the value of high-quality, genotype-matched references for resolving cultivar-specific stress and postharvest physiology in heterozygous perennial crops.
items.abstract_zh: 基于RNA-seq的转录组分析的准确性和可靠性本质上取决于参考基因组对所研究基因型的代表程度，尤其是在高度杂合、克隆繁殖且具有许多遗传上不同品种的作物（如苹果）中。在此，我们提出了染色体级别、亲本来源解析的Granny Smith基因组组装和高完整度注释（组装的BUSCO = 98.6%，两个单倍型；注释BUSCO = 98.7–98.9%）。为检验参考基因组选择如何影响转录组解释，我们将来自受阳光和遮阴暴露的Granny Smith果皮的RNA-seq数据分别比对到三个不同的苹果参考基因组：GDDH13（较早世代）、WA 38（现代世代）以及两个Granny Smith单倍型（现代且品种匹配）。尽管唯一比对率差异很小，使用现代参考的转录组分析在差异表达基因家族上显示出比GDDH13更高的一致性，而品种匹配的Granny Smith参考还恢复了与氧化应激、角质层生物学以及与阳光暴露和冷藏相关的其他过程有关的额外功能响应。重要的是，许多响应与同一实验材料先前鉴定的代谢组模式一致，为匹配参考所恢复的信号提供了独立生物学支持。参考依赖性差异在微妙的阳光暴露-贮藏交互中最大，表明随着生物学对比变得更精细，参考基因组的局限性变得更具影响。基于直系同源群的分析进一步表明，参考世代差异和旁系同源基因表示均导致跨基因组不一致。总之，这些结果表明，看似不大的比对性能差异可显著改变生物学结论，并突显高质量、基因型匹配参考对于解析杂合多年生作物中品种特异性胁迫和采后生理的价值。

items.title_en: Generation of neutron Bessel beams
items.title_zh: 中子贝塞尔光束的产生
items.abstract_en: Matter waves can exhibit structured wavefields analogous to those of light, offering new means of controlling the spatial and angular-momentum degrees of freedom of massive particles. Bessel beams are a fundamental class of structured waves that exhibit non-diffracting propagation, self-healing, and well-defined orbital angular momentum (OAM). Here, we experimentally realize neutron Bessel beams by imprinting a nanoscale conical phase gradient onto a neutron wavefront. By incorporating azimuthal phase gradients, we generate zeroth-, third-, and sixth-order Bessel beams, demonstrating direct control of both the OAM and radial structure of a massive particle. We also propose a neutron Bessel-grating interferometer, complementary to established optical and electron interferometric methods, in which varying the radial grating period by approximately 100 nm yields a controlled Gouy phase shift of $π$. These results establish neutron Bessel beams as a new platform for diffractive neutron focusing and provide an experimental foundation for theoretical studies of Bessel beams in neutron scattering, decay, and OAM characterization.
items.abstract_zh: 物质波可表现出类似于光的结构化波场，为控制大质量粒子的空间和角动量自由度提供了新手段。贝塞尔光束是一类基本的结构化波，具有无衍射传播、自修复和明确轨道角动量（OAM）的特性。在此，我们通过将纳米尺度锥形相位梯度压印到中子波前来实验实现中子贝塞尔光束。通过引入方位角相位梯度，我们产生零阶、三阶和六阶贝塞尔光束，展示了对大质量粒子OAM和径向结构的直接控制。我们还提出一种中子贝塞尔光栅干涉仪，与已有的光学和电子干涉方法互补；在其中将径向光栅周期改变约100 nm可产生π的受控Gouy相移。这些结果确立了中子贝塞尔光束作为衍射中子聚焦的新平台，并为中子散射、衰变和OAM表征中贝塞尔光束的理论研究提供了实验基础。

items.title_en: Uneven gains in protein-RNA affinity and mutation-effect prediction
items.title_zh: 蛋白质-RNA亲和力与突变效应预测中的不均衡增益
items.abstract_en: Accurate matched affinities determine mutation effects, but gains in aggregate affinity prediction may transfer unevenly to average effects, ordering and local accuracy. We evaluated eleven method families using method-specific matched populations. Controlled CoPRA reduced absolute-affinity mean absolute error from 1.2898 to 1.1431 pKd. Across 220 mutation pairs from 20 families, it generated stronger responses and improved mean-effect accuracy, with uncertain ranking gains and no decrease in mean centered local error. In an independent external test (24 quantitative pairs from three source-matched families), absolute and ordinary mutation-effect errors fell in all three families. Mean centered local error fell from 0.4198 to 0.3761 pKd, with improvements in two families and higher error in one. Error decomposition localized gains in landscape means. PRA-Pred feature tracing, fixed-weight M2-PRNet input controls and matched supervision interventions identified specific restrictions on mutation response. These results establish the need to evaluate average effects, ordering and quantitative local variation jointly.
items.abstract_zh: 准确的匹配亲和力决定突变效应，但总体亲和力预测的增益可能不均衡地迁移到平均效应、排序和局部准确性。我们使用方法特定的匹配群体评估了十一个方法家族。受控CoPRA将绝对亲和力平均绝对误差从1.2898降至1.1431 pKd。在来自20个家族的220个突变对中，它产生更强响应并提高平均效应准确度，排序增益不确定，且均值中心化局部误差没有降低。在一项独立外部测试中（来自三个来源匹配家族的24个定量对），三个家族的绝对误差和普通突变效应误差均下降。均值中心化局部误差从0.4198降至0.3761 pKd，其中两个家族改善，一个家族误差更高。误差分解将增益定位在景观均值。PRA-Pred特征追踪、固定权重M2-PRNet输入控制和匹配监督干预识别出对突变响应的特定限制。这些结果确立了联合评估平均效应、排序和定量局部变异的必要性。

items.title_en: Beyond Replacement: Levenshtein Editing for Diffusion Language Models
items.title_zh: 超越替换：面向扩散语言模型的Levenshtein编辑
items.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer a flexible alternative to autoregressive models, enabling any-order infilling. While most existing decoding methods treat decoded tokens as fixed, some recent models allow previously decoded tokens to be revised only by replacing them with alternative tokens, a paradigm we refer to as replacement-only editing (ROE). Although ROE can correct individual tokens, it is inefficient for sequence shifts caused by missing or extra tokens and struggles when errors occur across many positions. To address these limitations, we propose LED (Levenshtein Editing for Diffusion Language Models), a post-training framework that extends ROE with insertion and deletion, enabling Levenshtein-style refinement of generated sequences. It uses two training designs. First, it reconstructs edit supervision on the fly during supervised fine-tuning using longest-common-subsequence alignment, enabling insertion and deletion learning without manually annotated labels. Second, it adopts multi-stage training, where the state from one stage becomes the input to the next, exposing the model to its earlier errors and enabling it to correct them. When applied to the 16B-parameter LLaDA2.1-Mini Base, LED raises the average score across twelve benchmarks from 54.86 to 57.10 under confidence-guided decoding while increasing tokens per forward from 6.14 to 7.05, whereas under confidence-free decoding it raises the average score from 27.52 to 47.19. We further show that LED achieves higher pass@k at large k than thresholded decoding without editing, demonstrating improved generation diversity and revealing the diversity potential of DLMs without confidence guidance. LED also improves robustness to large block sizes, raising the average score from 36.97 to 51.34 at block size 128. Together, these results suggest that LED supports more robust self-correction in DLMs.
items.abstract_zh: 扩散语言模型（DLM）为自回归模型提供了灵活的替代方案，能够实现任意顺序填充。虽然大多数现有解码方法将已解码token视为固定，一些近期模型允许仅通过用替代token替换来修正先前解码的token，我们将这一范式称为仅替换编辑（ROE）。尽管ROE可以修正单个token，但对于由缺失或多余token引起的序列移位效率低下，并且在许多位置发生错误时难以处理。为解决这些局限，我们提出LED（Levenshtein Editing for Diffusion Language Models），这是一个通过插入和删除扩展ROE的后训练框架，能够对生成序列进行Levenshtein式细化。它采用两种训练设计。首先，它在监督微调期间使用最长公共子序列对齐即时重建编辑监督，从而无需人工标注标签即可学习插入和删除。其次，它采用多阶段训练，其中一个阶段的状态成为下一阶段的输入，使模型暴露于其较早错误并能够修正这些错误。应用于160亿参数的LLaDA2.1-Mini Base时，LED在置信度引导解码下将十二个基准的平均分数从54.86提高到57.10，同时将每次前向的token数从6.14提高到7.05；而在无置信度解码下，它将平均分数从27.52提高到47.19。我们进一步表明，LED在大k时比未编辑的阈值解码获得更高的pass@k，证明生成多样性得到改善，并揭示DLM在无置信度引导下的多样性潜力。LED还提高了对大块大小的鲁棒性，在块大小为128时将平均分数从36.97提高到51.34。总之，这些结果表明LED支持DLM中更稳健的自我修正。

items.title_en: Learning Martial Arts Motion Skills for Animating Opponents in VR Sparring Games
items.title_zh: 学习武术动作技能用于VR对打游戏中对手动画
items.abstract_en: Animating virtual opponents is an important yet challenging task in game development. In martial arts games, opponent motions must not only be physically plausible but also exhibit appropriate technique, timing, transitions, and target-directed intent. Traditional game animations often rely on handcrafted clips, state machine transitions, and procedural adjustments, which can be labor-intensive and may limit the behavioral diversity of non-player characters. This paper presents a martial arts motion skills learning framework for character animation in virtual sparring games. Inspired by Tang Soo Do, we collected a martial arts motion capture dataset containing isolated attacking and defending techniques, technique combinations and transitions, and contextual sparring variations. We first pretrained a reusable repertoire of martial arts motion skills from the captured data using reinforcement learning (RL) with adversarial style rewards, and then adapted these skills with task-specific rewards for target-directed striking and threat-aware evasion. We evaluated the motions generated by the learned policy through a user study, in which participants assessed their physical plausibility, smoothness, and martial arts form. To demonstrate their applicability to interactive gameplay, we developed a VR sparring prototype for Meta Quest headsets. The prototype combines policy-generated motion clips with lightweight state-based control to support interactive opponent behavior. Together, these findings support the feasibility of using a learned martial arts skill repertoire as a motion foundation for animating opponents in VR sparring games.
items.abstract_zh: 为虚拟对手制作动画是游戏开发中一项重要但具有挑战性的任务。在武术游戏中，对手动作不仅必须在物理上合理，还必须表现出适当的技术、时机、过渡和目标导向意图。传统游戏动画通常依赖手工制作的片段、状态机过渡和程序化调整，这可能劳动密集，并可能限制非玩家角色的行为多样性。本文提出一个用于虚拟对打游戏中角色动画的武术动作技能学习框架。受唐手道启发，我们收集了一个武术动作捕捉数据集，包含孤立的攻击和防御技术、技术组合与过渡，以及情境化对打变体。我们首先使用带有对抗式风格奖励的强化学习（RL）从捕获数据中预训练可复用的武术动作技能库，然后使用任务特定奖励将这些技能适配于目标导向击打和威胁感知闪避。我们通过用户研究评估学习策略生成的动作，参与者评估其物理合理性、平滑性和武术动作形态。为展示其在交互式游戏中的适用性，我们为Meta Quest头显开发了一个VR对打原型。该原型将策略生成的动作片段与轻量级基于状态的控制相结合，以支持交互式对手行为。总之，这些发现支持将学习到的武术技能库作为VR对打游戏中对手动画动作基础的可行性。

items.title_en: STAR++: A Physical-Aware Benchmark and Framework for Astronomical Super-Resolution across Multiple Filters
items.title_zh: STAR++：面向多滤光片天文超分辨率的物理感知基准与框架
items.abstract_en: Astronomical super-resolution (ASR) aims to reconstruct high-resolution star fields from low-resolution telescope observations across multiple filters for astrophysical analysis. However, developing a physics-aware ASR framework faces two challenges: 1) Data view: no large-scale benchmark supports field-level ASR, especially on unseen filters. 2) Method view: Existing ASR methods often fail to preserve stellar flux across spatial resolutions. Moreover, ASR requires reconstructing high-frequency components, including accurate star locations and profiles, making it more ill-posed than natural-image SR. To tackle these problems, we introduce STAR++, a large-scale benchmark comprising approximately 1.7 million flux-consistent image pairs across 36 filters, derived from Hubble Space Telescope (HST) observations. STAR++ uses a flux-preserving data generation pipeline to ensure photometric consistency across resolutions and provides the Flux Error (FE) metric to evaluate ASR models from a physical perspective. To address method-level challenges, we propose a Flux-Invariant Super-Resolution Plus (FISR++) model that generalizes to unseen filters while accurately reconstructing flux-consistent high-resolution images. Beyond the flux-preserving modules, FISR++ introduces two novel components. Specifically, a Filter-Aware Adapter (FAA) incorporates filter metadata to adapt image representations to varying spectral and optical conditions. In addition, a Spatial Ambiguity Disentangle Loss (SADL) models spatial ambiguity as pixel-shift uncertainty, mitigating the smoothing of learned conditional mean reconstructions caused by this ambiguity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FISR++ consistently outperforms existing ASR methods in reconstruction quality and flux accuracy, while generalizing to unseen filters, highlighting its effectiveness for photometrically faithful ASR.
items.abstract_zh: 天文超分辨率（ASR）旨在从多滤光片的低分辨率望远镜观测中重建高分辨率星场，以用于天体物理分析。然而，开发物理感知的ASR框架面临两个挑战：1）数据视角：没有大规模基准支持场级ASR，尤其是在未见滤光片上。2）方法视角：现有ASR方法往往无法在不同空间分辨率间保持恒星通量。此外，ASR需要重建高频成分，包括准确的恒星位置和轮廓，使其比自然图像SR更病态。为解决这些问题，我们提出STAR++，一个大规模基准，包含约170万对通量一致的图像对，覆盖36个滤光片，源自哈勃空间望远镜（HST）观测。STAR++采用通量保持的数据生成流程，以确保跨分辨率的光度一致性，并提供通量误差（FE）指标，从物理角度评估ASR模型。为应对方法层面的挑战，我们提出通量不变超分辨率增强模型（Flux-Invariant Super-Resolution Plus，FISR++），其可泛化到未见滤光片，同时准确重建通量一致的高分辨率图像。除通量保持模块外，FISR++引入两个新组件。具体而言，滤光片感知适配器（Filter-Aware Adapter，FAA）纳入滤光片元数据，使图像表示适应不同的光谱和光学条件。此外，空间歧义解缠损失（Spatial Ambiguity Disentangle Loss，SADL）将空间歧义建模为像素偏移不确定性，缓解该歧义导致的学习条件均值重建平滑化。大量实验表明，FISR++在重建质量和通量精度上持续优于现有ASR方法，同时可泛化到未见滤光片，突显其用于光度忠实ASR的有效性。

items.title_en: Unexpected properties of nucleotide condensates could facilitate the RNA world
items.title_zh: 核苷酸凝聚体的意外性质可能促进RNA世界
items.abstract_en: A key question in the RNA world hypothesis for the origin of life is the nature of the compartment that separates and protects the RNA from its environment. While membranes are a leading candidate for the initial compartment, biomolecular condensates have been proposed as an alternative, possibly simpler route to compartments. Here we show that bona fide liquid condensates form spontaneously when nucleotides (such as ATP) are mixed with divalent cations and a short-chain alcohol or diol in water. These condensates do not require any polymer to form, but can concentrate polymers like RNA and DNA, which show unexpected chemical behavior inside the condensates. Most surprisingly, RNA survives for days inside nucleotide condensates under acidic conditions that cause rapid and extensive hydrolysis in bulk. This effect is also observed for a phosphate-ester model substrate and therefore likely reflects the suppression of backbone cleavage. Coarse-grained simulations suggest that the condensate interior is bound together by magnesium-phosphate bridging interactions and is therefore highly depleted of water. At neutral pH, the same compartment reverses the course of a hammerhead ribozyme reaction, shifting it from cleavage toward religation. Finally, we observe that nucleotide droplets also spontaneously organize phospholipids at their surface, suggesting a possible evolutionary route from biomolecular condensates toward membranes. Thus, we believe that nucleotide condensates, which are built from the same building blocks as the genetic polymers themselves, overcome long-standing challenges with the RNA world hypothesis for the origin of life by protecting nucleic acids and reshaping their chemistry.
items.abstract_zh: RNA世界假说中关于生命起源的一个关键问题是，分隔并保护RNA免受环境影响的区室具有何种性质。虽然膜是初始区室的主要候选，但生物分子凝聚体被提出作为替代且可能更简单的区室形成途径。在这里，我们表明，当核苷酸（如ATP）与二价阳离子以及短链醇或二醇在水中混合时，会自发形成真正的液体凝聚体。这些凝聚体不需要任何聚合物即可形成，但能够富集RNA和DNA等聚合物，而这些聚合物在凝聚体内部表现出意外的化学行为。最令人惊讶的是，在会导致本体溶液中快速且广泛水解的酸性条件下，RNA在核苷酸凝聚体内可存活数天。这种效应也在磷酸酯模型底物上观察到，因此可能反映了主链断裂受到抑制。粗粒化模拟表明，凝聚体内部通过镁-磷酸桥联相互作用结合在一起，因此高度缺水。在中性pH下，同一区室会逆转锤头状核酶反应的方向，使其从切割转向重新连接。最后，我们观察到核苷酸液滴还会在其表面自发组织磷脂，提示从生物分子凝聚体向膜演化的可能路径。因此，我们认为，核苷酸凝聚体由与遗传聚合物本身相同的构建单元构成，通过保护核酸并重塑其化学性质，克服了RNA世界生命起源假说中长期存在的挑战。

items.title_en: A Convex-Roof Affinity-Square Measure of Quantum Imaginarity
items.title_zh: 量子虚数性的凸顶亲和平方度量
items.abstract_en: Quantum imaginarity characterizes the part of a quantum state that cannot be represented by real density matrices in a fixed reference basis. We study an affinity-square measure of imaginarity for pure states and its convex-roof extension to mixed states. The pure state quantity is defined by minimizing the affinity-square measure over the convex set of real states. This optimization admits a closed expression determined by the modulus of the conjugation overlap between a state and its complex conjugate. The measure vanishes precisely when the state is real up to a global phase. We prove that the convex-roof extension is faithful, convex, monotone under real operations, and nonincreasing on average under selective real operations. For arbitrary single-qubit mixed states, we evaluate the convex roof exactly and express it in terms of the imaginary component of the off-diagonal density-matrix element. We also compare pure-state imaginarity with an auxiliary affinity-square coherence functional and give the corresponding phase weights.
items.abstract_zh: 量子虚数性刻画量子态中无法在固定参考基下由实密度矩阵表示的部分。我们研究纯态虚数性的亲和平方度量及其对混合态的凸顶扩展。纯态量定义为在实态的凸集上最小化亲和平方度量。该优化具有闭式表达式，由态与其复共轭之间共轭重叠的模确定。该度量恰在态在全局相位下为实时为零。我们证明凸顶扩展忠实、凸、在实操作下单调，并在选择性实操作下平均不增。对于任意单量子比特混合态，我们精确计算凸顶，并用非对角密度矩阵元素的虚部表示。我们还将纯态虚数性与辅助亲和平方相干泛函进行比较，并给出相应的相位权重。

items.title_en: Recurrent Domain Incremental Adaptation of Time-Series Foundation Models
items.title_zh: 时间序列基础模型的循环式域增量适应
items.abstract_en: Pretrained Time-Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) provide strong representations for downstream classification tasks. Yet adapting a TSFM under changing operating conditions remains challenging. A model must improve on each newly observed condition without sacrificing conditions it has already learned, often from only a small labeled calibration set and without knowing the operating condition at inference time. We find that this difficulty has an important geometric structure. Under an operating-condition shift, the embedding space of a TSFM does not move uniformly: some local regions change substantially, while others remain nearly unchanged. Consequently, a global adaptation can unnecessarily move embeddings that were already correctly classified. To address this, we propose the novel PACT (Piecewise Adaptation via Chart Transport). PACT partitions the frozen source embedding space into local charts and learns lightweight residual transports for the regions affected by each new condition. An explicit identity path is always retained, and a learned gate softly selects among the identity and accumulated transports for each input. The pretrained TSFM encoder, classifier head, and previously learned transports remain fixed. With only 5% labeled calibration data per arriving condition and no condition identity at test time, PACT maintains an average macro-F1 above 0.95 across a four-condition bearing-fault stream. Under homogeneous tasks and label spaces, similar retention-adaptation behavior is observed across public benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/Sachithx/PACT.
items.abstract_zh: 预训练时间序列基础模型（TSFM）为下游分类任务提供强表示。然而，在运行条件变化下适应TSFM仍具挑战。模型必须在每个新观测条件下改进，同时不牺牲已学条件，通常仅来自小型有标签校准集，且在推理时不知道运行条件。我们发现这一困难具有重要几何结构。在运行条件偏移下，TSFM的嵌入空间并非均匀移动：一些局部区域显著变化，而另一些几乎不变。因此，全局适应可能不必要地移动已正确分类的嵌入。为此，我们提出PACT（Piecewise Adaptation via Chart Transport，基于图卡传输的分段适应）。PACT将冻结的源嵌入空间划分为局部图卡，并为每个新条件影响的区域学习轻量残差传输。始终保留显式恒等路径，学习的门控对每个输入在恒等传输和累积传输之间进行软选择。预训练TSFM编码器、分类头以及先前学习的传输保持固定。在每个到来条件仅有5%有标签校准数据且测试时无条件身份的情况下，PACT在四条件轴承故障流上保持平均macro-F1高于0.95。在同质任务和标签空间下，公共基准上观察到类似的保持-适应行为。代码见 https://github.com/Sachithx/PACT。

items.title_en: Thinking Fast, Anywhere: One System-1 for the Decision Points of Any Agent Workflow
items.title_zh: 快速思考，随处可用：为任意智能体工作流的决策点提供一个System-1
items.abstract_en: Autonomous LLM agents incur substantial cost and latency by invoking a large model (System-2) at every step, even when many intermediate actions choose among a small set of known candidates. Existing dual-system agents offload such decisions to a lightweight System-1 model, but rely on workflow-specific hooks authored per environment. We present AnyS1, a framework that turns human-authored procedural skills, whose instructions naturally specify where choices arise and which options apply, into a shared, domain-general source of decision points. Offline, AnyS1 mines grounded enumerable decisions across over 1,000 public skills, gathers execution-grounded trajectory states inside isolated containers to construct Any-DP, and trains a single calibrated 4B pointer System-1 with label smoothing. At run time, compiled workflows resolve routine decisions in one forward pass and fall back to System-2 when confidence falls below a calibrated threshold. Across three unseen benchmarks and distinct System-2 model families, AnyS1 preserves task reliability while cutting episode cost by 75-91% and model-call time by 63-92% relative to an uncompiled System-2 agent, and maintains performance under zero-shot threshold transfer.
items.abstract_zh: 自主LLM智能体在每一步调用大模型（System-2）会带来显著成本和延迟，即使许多中间动作只是在一小组已知候选者中选择。现有双系统智能体将此类决策卸载到轻量System-1模型，但依赖为每个环境编写的工作流专用钩子。我们提出AnyS1，一个框架，将人类编写的程序性技能（其指令自然指定选择出现的位置以及适用哪些选项）转化为共享的、领域通用的决策点来源。离线阶段，AnyS1在超过1,000个公共技能中挖掘有据可依的可枚举决策，在隔离容器内收集基于执行的轨迹状态以构建Any-DP，并使用标签平滑训练单个经过校准的4B指针System-1。运行时，编译后的工作流在一次前向传播中解决常规决策，并在置信度低于校准阈值时回退到System-2。在三个未见基准和不同的System-2模型家族上，AnyS1保持任务可靠性，同时相对于未编译的System-2智能体将回合成本降低75-91%，模型调用时间降低63-92%，并在零样本阈值迁移下保持性能。

items.title_en: Measuring the Conservatism of Latent Safety Filters for World Models
items.title_zh: 度量世界模型潜在安全过滤器的保守性
items.abstract_en: A latent safety filter decides from the latent of a world model whether a planned action is safe. Conformal calibration sets the threshold of the filter so that it accepts an unsafe action only with a small probability. However, the filter can still be conservative and refuse many safe actions, depending on the latent. To measure the conservatism that a latent forces on the filter, we group similar latents and actions into cells. A filter that gives one decision per cell can refuse the unsafe transitions of a cell only by refusing the safe ones in it as well. We call the share of safe transitions that lie in such cells the overlap. We prove that the overlap is the minimum share of safe transitions that such a filter has to refuse in order to accept no unsafe transition in the data. Both the overlap and the conformal calibration can be applied to any latent. We use this to compare three existing designs, in which the safety labels train a classifier on top of the world model, the world model itself, or a separate encoder beside it. In a visual navigation task, the separate encoder has the lowest overlap, and at the same conformal level its filter refuses the fewest safe actions and lets the planner reach the most goals of the three.
items.abstract_zh: 潜在安全过滤器根据世界模型的潜在表示判断计划动作是否安全。保形校准设置过滤器阈值，使其仅以较小概率接受不安全动作。然而，过滤器仍可能保守，并拒绝许多安全动作，具体取决于潜在表示。为度量潜在表示迫使过滤器产生的保守性，我们将相似的潜在表示和动作分组为单元。每个单元给出一个决策的过滤器，若要拒绝某单元中的不安全转移，就只能同时拒绝该单元中的安全转移。我们将位于此类单元中的安全转移所占比例称为重叠率。我们证明，重叠率是此类过滤器为在数据中不接受任何不安全转移而必须拒绝的安全转移的最小比例。重叠率和保形校准均可应用于任何潜在表示。我们以此比较三种现有设计：其中安全标签在世界模型之上训练分类器、使用世界模型本身，或使用其旁边的单独编码器。在视觉导航任务中，单独编码器的重叠率最低；在相同保形水平下，其过滤器拒绝的安全动作最少，并使规划器在三种设计中达到最多目标。

items.title_en: SCOPE: Single-Cell Omics Prediction from Histology via RNA-Protein Prior Enhancement
items.title_zh: SCOPE：通过RNA-蛋白质先验增强从组织学图像预测单细胞组学
items.abstract_en: Predicting the RNA and protein content of cells from routine H&E images could extend spatial molecular profiling to existing slide archives. However, both H&E-spatial proteomics and H&E-spatial transcriptomics paired datasets are limited by the number of available markers and the insufficient availability of high-quality, cell-resolved data. We present SCOPE (Single-Cell Omics Prediction via RNA-protein prior Enhancement), a unified framework that leverages biologically complementary information between RNA and proteins to address the limited availability of single-omics supervision. Our key insight is that, although RNA and proteins represent distinct molecular modalities, their biological relationships provide valuable shared knowledge that can benefit single-omics prediction tasks. To this end, SCOPE introduces biologically informed biomarker priors to enhance shared gene-level representations, enabling knowledge transfer across RNA and protein modalities through gene-protein correspondence and molecular associations. By exploiting these complementary relationships, SCOPE enables both prediction tasks to benefit from a shared backbone enriched with cross-omics biological knowledge. Furthermore, its biomarker correlation design facilitates the prediction of unseen markers, extending spatially resolved molecular profiling beyond directly supervised targets. Across test datasets spanning 16 organs, SCOPE improves the average RNA Pearson correlation over the strongest baseline by 8.8%. On two external protein cohorts, it improves the average Pearson correlation over the strongest baseline by 9.7% for seen markers and 11.9% for unseen markers.
items.abstract_zh: 从常规H&E图像预测细胞的RNA和蛋白质含量，有望将空间分子图谱扩展到现有的切片档案。然而，H&E-空间蛋白质组学和H&E-空间转录组学的配对数据集均受限于可用标志物的数量以及高质量、细胞分辨率数据的不足。我们提出SCOPE（Single-Cell Omics Prediction via RNA-protein prior Enhancement，通过RNA-蛋白质先验增强进行单细胞组学预测），这是一个统一框架，利用RNA与蛋白质之间的生物学互补信息，以应对单组学监督有限的问题。我们的关键洞察是：尽管RNA和蛋白质代表不同的分子模态，它们之间的生物学关系提供了有价值的共享知识，可惠及单组学预测任务。为此，SCOPE引入具有生物学依据的生物标志物先验来增强共享的基因水平表示，通过基因-蛋白质对应关系和分子关联实现跨RNA和蛋白质模态的知识迁移。通过利用这些互补关系，SCOPE使两项预测任务都能受益于一个富含跨组学生物学知识的共享骨干网络。此外，其生物标志物相关性设计有助于预测未见标志物，将空间分辨分子图谱扩展到直接监督目标之外。在涵盖16个器官的测试数据集上，SCOPE将平均RNA Pearson相关性较最强基线提升8.8%。在两个外部蛋白质队列上，对于已见标志物，其平均Pearson相关性较最强基线提升9.7%；对于未见标志物提升11.9%。

items.title_en: Structure of CPC-PP2A(B56) Kinase-Phosphatase Signaling Hub in Chromosome Segregation Fidelity
items.title_zh: CPC-PP2A(B56)激酶-磷酸酶信号枢纽在染色体分离保真性中的结构
items.abstract_en: Accurate chromosome segregation relies on kinase-phosphatase crosstalk that controls protein interactions underpinning sister chromatid cohesion, error correction and timely anaphase onset. The PP2A(B56) phosphatase and the Aurora B kinase-containing Chromosomal Passenger Complex (CPC), two central mitotic regulators, are independently recruited to centromeres by Shugoshin1 (Sgo1). Here, using biochemical reconstitutions and cryo-electron microscopy, we show that PP2A(B56) and CPC form an integrated signaling platform independent of Sgo1. The CPC binds PP2A(B56) directly through two Borealin elements: a previously uncharacterized LxxIxE-like motif and the dimerization domain. Sgo1 selectively remodels the dimerization-domain interface, while the LxxIxE-like motif sustains PP2A(B56)-CPC association. Disrupting this interaction increases chromosome segregation errors, compromising segregation fidelity. Our findings reveal a direct kinase-phosphatase association as an additional layer of mitotic regulation that safeguards segregation fidelity.
items.abstract_zh: 准确的染色体分离依赖于激酶-磷酸酶串扰，该串扰控制着支撑姐妹染色单体黏连、错误校正和及时进入后期的蛋白质相互作用。PP2A(B56)磷酸酶和含Aurora B激酶的染色体乘客复合体（CPC）这两个核心有丝分裂调控因子，由Shugoshin1（Sgo1）独立招募至着丝粒。在此，我们利用生化重构和冷冻电镜表明，PP2A(B56)与CPC形成不依赖Sgo1的整合信号平台。CPC通过两个Borealin元件直接结合PP2A(B56)：一个此前未表征的类LxxIxE基序和二聚化结构域。Sgo1选择性重塑二聚化结构域界面，而类LxxIxE基序维持PP2A(B56)-CPC结合。破坏该相互作用会增加染色体分离错误，损害分离保真性。我们的发现揭示了一种直接的激酶-磷酸酶结合，作为有丝分裂调控的额外一层，保障分离保真性。

items.title_en: A Universal Diffusion Model for the Quantum Position Operator
items.title_zh: 量子位置算符的通用扩散模型
items.abstract_en: The quantum position operator and its response to perturbations underpin the functional properties of insulating materials. In the modern theory of polarization, Wannier charge centres encode Berry-phase polarization, while their structural derivatives determine key response functions. Here we introduce a universal diffusion model based on E(3)-equivariant graph neural networks for moments of the position operator, with the first moment defining Wannier centres and the second central moment their real-space localization. We demonstrate the framework for liquid water, amorphous silicon and crystalline BaTiO$_3$, and train a universal model that generalizes to 100 unseen crystals spanning a 67-species chemical space. The predicted centres reproduce infrared spectra in large liquid and amorphous cells beyond routine first-principles reach and enable finite-difference calculations of Born effective charges and piezoelectric tensors. This framework provides a scalable route to electronic polarization and localization in complex materials, supporting high-throughput screening and finite-temperature simulations.
items.abstract_zh: 量子位置算符及其对微扰的响应是绝缘材料功能特性的基础。在现代极化理论中，Wannier电荷中心编码Berry相位极化，而其结构导数决定关键响应函数。在此，我们提出一种基于E(3)等变图神经网络的通用扩散模型，用于位置算符的各阶矩，其中一阶矩定义Wannier中心，二阶中心矩定义其在实空间中的局域化。我们在液态水、非晶硅和晶态BaTiO$_3$上演示了该框架，并训练了一个通用模型，可泛化到跨越67种元素化学空间的100种未见晶体。预测的中心能够在超出常规第一性原理计算能力的大型液体和非晶胞中重现红外光谱，并支持Born有效电荷和压电张量的有限差分计算。该框架为复杂材料中的电子极化和局域化提供了一条可扩展的途径，支持高通量筛选和有限温度模拟。

items.title_en: Knowing What You Know: A Trait Theory of Reviewer Value in Human-AI Cognitive Systems
items.title_zh: 知道自己知道什么：人-AI认知系统中审阅者价值的特质理论
items.abstract_en: When a capable model and a human reviewer cooperate on the same decision, which human still adds value? We argue this is a question about a single cognitive trait, metacognitive calibration: the alignment between a reviewer's behavioral confidence and the actual correctness of their judgments. We develop a trait theory of reviewer value to make it precise. The theory makes five claims: value is governed by calibration rather than by activity, speed, agreement, or tenure; calibration leaves observable traces in behavioral telemetry; those traces are non-diagnostic on their own, because the fast, low-revision signature of a calibrated expert is indistinguishable from that of a confident novice until it is gated by outcomes; human calibration and a model's self-knowledge are the same construct, so the joint system should defer to whichever agent is better calibrated on each item; and individual calibration is causally identifiable only above the level of the single judgment. We ground each claim in a six-month production window of an AI-assisted accounting system (541621 reviewer events, 483 reviewers), and find that a purely behavioral expertise profile inverts the ground truth, scoring an overconfident cohort (5.2 percent correction survival) higher than genuine experts (99.2 percent); that reviewer quality is flat across tenure, so the trait is not learned on the job; and that the same calibration logic that separates good from bad reviewers, applied to the model, concentrates 92.5 percent of human effort on genuine errors. We close with the boundary the theory must respect: under majority-vote aggregation, individual causal value is unidentifiable.
items.abstract_zh: 当一个有能力的模型和人类审阅者就同一决策开展合作时，哪类人仍能增加价值？我们认为，这是一个关于单一认知特质的问题，即元认知校准：审阅者的行为置信度与其判断实际正确性之间的一致性。我们构建了一种审阅者价值的特质理论，以使其精确化。该理论提出五项主张：价值由校准而非活动量、速度、一致性或任期决定；校准会在行为遥测中留下可观察痕迹；这些痕迹本身并非诊断性的，因为校准良好的专家快速、低修订的特征与自信的新手难以区分，除非以结果为门控；人类校准与模型的自我知识是同一构念，因此联合系统应在每个条目上服从校准更好的智能体；个体校准仅在高于单次判断的层面上具有因果可识别性。我们将每项主张建立在一个人工智能辅助会计系统为期六个月的生产窗口数据上（541621个审阅事件，483名审阅者），发现纯行为专长画像会颠倒真实情况，将过度自信群体（5.2%修正存活率）评分高于真正专家（99.2%）；审阅者质量在不同任期上持平，因此该特质并非在工作中习得；并且，将区分好坏审阅者的同一校准逻辑应用于模型，可使92.5%的人力集中于真实错误。最后，我们指出该理论必须尊重的边界：在多数投票聚合下，个体因果价值不可识别。

items.title_en: Chorus: Shared N-gram Embeddings with Layer-wise Adaptation
items.title_zh: Chorus：具有逐层适配的共享N-gram嵌入
items.abstract_en: Language models can gain capacity at little computational cost from n-gram embedding tables: large tables of learned vectors for short sequences of consecutive tokens, which are looked up and added to the model's input or to its intermediate layers. Recent designs commonly use a separate n-gram embedding table for each layer, which makes the tables costly in memory and prevents layers from sharing what they learn. Sharing a single table, however, gives every layer the same embedding and leaves no room for layer-wise preferences, and it performs poorly in practice. We propose Chorus, in which one set of n-gram embedding tables serves the whole network and every layer reads it in its own way. Each layer maps the refined embedding through its own projection layer, after rescaling its components by factors computed from its current hidden state. Chorus matches the quality of existing n-gram methods with 87% smaller tables: with 1.2B table parameters it predicts text better than FactorEngram and DeepSeek's Engram do with 9.6B. It outperforms Engram, TN-gram and FactorEngram in every setting where we compared them, across table sizes from 20M to 9.6B parameters. We also show that the recently proposed memory-efficient optimizer Ember works well with Chorus, saving 99.2% of table-optimizer memory compared with AdamW without degrading training performance. These results enable further scaling of n-gram embedding tables along the table-size axis by reducing memory use and allowing shared knowledge to be reused across layers.
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型可以通过n-gram嵌入表以很小的计算成本获得容量：这些大表为连续词元的短序列存储学习到的向量，通过查找并加到模型输入或其中间层。近期设计通常为每一层使用单独的n-gram嵌入表，这使表在内存上代价高昂，并阻止层间共享所学内容。然而，共享单个表会使每一层获得相同的嵌入，没有为逐层偏好留下空间，且在实践中表现不佳。我们提出Chorus，其中一组n-gram嵌入表服务于整个网络，每一层以自己的方式读取它。每一层在根据其当前隐藏状态计算出的因子对嵌入分量进行重新缩放后，通过自己的投影层映射精炼后的嵌入。Chorus以小87%的表匹配现有n-gram方法的质量：以12亿表参数，其文本预测效果优于FactorEngram和DeepSeek的Engram以96亿参数所达到的效果。在我们比较的每种设置中，其性能均优于Engram、TN-gram和FactorEngram，表规模从2000万到96亿参数。我们还表明，近期提出的内存高效优化器Ember与Chorus配合良好，与AdamW相比节省99.2%的表优化器内存，且不降低训练性能。这些结果通过降低内存使用并允许共享知识在层间复用，使n-gram嵌入表能够沿表规模轴进一步扩展。

items.title_en: CADENCE: Learning Acyclic Gaits for Model-Based Quadruped Locomotion
items.title_zh: CADENCE：为基于模型的四足运动学习非周期步态
items.abstract_en: Model-based quadruped controllers usually step on a cyclic gait, which lifts the legs in a fixed order on a fixed period, wherever the safe footholds are. We present CADENCE, a learned step planner with a small action space. Every 40 ms, it picks one of at most 65 discrete choices: no step, or one leg's step to a safe foothold. It also predicts a swing time. We train CADENCE by reinforcement learning on top of a convex model predictive controller (MPC). Nothing prescribes a gait: there is no gait schedule, and the reward has no gait term, only a cost per step. The one structural constraint is that at most two legs may swing at once. The policy we analyzed developed an acyclic gait, with no fixed period or stepping order, yet it still paired diagonal legs. An inverse footstep model (IFM), fitted on a controller's logged steps, turns each foothold into a command. With only the IFM refitted, on fewer than 20,000 steps, CADENCE ran frozen on OCS2's nonlinear MPC. In simulated trials on a range of terrains (26% to 49% voids) and speeds (0.1 m/s and 0.2 m/s), it succeeded in 85.1% (mean of five seeds), against 67.8% for OCS2-Trot, 65.5% for OCS2-Single, and 39.6% in a static walk ablation of CADENCE. At 49% voids, it succeeded in 72.9%, against 43.0% for OCS2-Trot.
items.abstract_zh: 基于模型的四足控制器通常采用周期性步态行走，无论安全落脚点在哪里，都以固定周期、固定顺序抬腿。我们提出CADENCE，一种具有小动作空间的学习型落步规划器。每40毫秒，它从至多65个离散选项中选择一个：不迈步，或某条腿迈向安全落脚点的一步。它还预测摆动时间。我们在凸模型预测控制器（MPC）之上通过强化学习训练CADENCE。没有任何东西规定步态：没有步态调度，奖励中没有步态项，只有每步的成本。唯一的结构性约束是最多两条腿可同时摆动。我们分析得到的策略发展出非周期步态，没有固定周期或迈步顺序，但仍将对角腿配对。逆足步模型（IFM）在控制器记录的步态数据上拟合，将每个落脚点转换为命令。仅重新拟合IFM，在少于20,000步的数据上，CADENCE便以冻结状态运行在OCS2的非线性MPC上。在一系列地形（26%至49%空洞）和速度（0.1 m/s和0.2 m/s）的模拟试验中，其成功率为85.1%（五个随机种子的均值），而OCS2-Trot为67.8%，OCS2-Single为65.5%，CADENCE的静态行走消融为39.6%。在49%空洞条件下，其成功率为72.9%，而OCS2-Trot为43.0%。

items.title_en: EyeDiT: Anatomy-Grounded Multi-Modal Eye Generation and Simulation
items.title_zh: EyeDiT：以解剖结构为基础的多模态眼睛生成与仿真
items.abstract_en: Synthetic eye data are critical for rapid development of eye tracking (ET) in AR/VR applications. However, existing synthetic eye generators are largely image-centric and lack a high-quality underlying 3D anatomy of the eye, which limits their control mainly to the gaze and provides no anatomical labels. To address this problem, we propose EyeDiT, an anatomy-grounded, multi-modal 3D eye generation and simulation model trained with optical coherence tomography (OCT), labeled anatomy point clouds and near-eye images. Our pipeline first trains a Multi-Modal Anatomy Variational Autoencoder (VAE), which encodes an anatomy-aware latent representation from all input modalities. Then, our Eye Latent DiT is trained to generate latent samples conditioned on the optical axis, the pupil position and radius, and the subject identity. Together with Gaussian decoders for novel-view simulation, our model enables control over the pupil, subject identity and viewpoint for data synthesis. We show that our model outperforms previous eye image synthesis models in novel-view synthesis (24.9 against 21.8 dB PSNR from a single view), and that a public ET neural network trained on our synthetic data shows a smaller sim-to-real gap than when trained on data from other generators (3.5$^\circ$ vs. 8.4$^\circ$ gaze error), approaches a network trained on real data, and further improves ET performance when combined with real data (2.3$^\circ$ vs. 2.6$^\circ$). More information is available on the project page: https://lyhan12.github.io/eyedit
items.abstract_zh: 合成眼睛数据对于在 AR/VR 应用中快速开发眼动追踪（ET）至关重要。然而，现有的合成眼睛生成器大多以图像为中心，缺乏高质量的底层三维眼睛解剖结构，这使它们的控制主要局限于注视方向，并且不提供解剖标签。为解决这一问题，我们提出 EyeDiT，一个以解剖结构为基础的多模态三维眼睛生成与仿真模型，使用光学相干断层扫描（OCT）、带标注的解剖点云和近眼图像进行训练。我们的流程首先训练一个多模态解剖变分自编码器（VAE），它从所有输入模态中编码出解剖感知的潜在表示。然后，我们的 Eye Latent DiT 被训练为以光轴、瞳孔位置与半径以及受试者身份为条件生成潜在样本。结合用于新视角仿真的高斯解码器，我们的模型能够对瞳孔、受试者身份和视角进行控制以用于数据合成。我们表明，我们的模型在新视角合成上优于先前的眼睛图像合成模型（单视图下 24.9 dB 对 21.8 dB PSNR），并且一个在我們的合成数据上训练的公开 ET 神经网络，与其他生成器生成的数据训练相比，表现出更小的仿真到现实差距（3.5$^\circ$ 对 8.4$^\circ$ 注视误差），接近在真实数据上训练的网络，并且与真实数据结合时进一步改善 ET 性能（2.3$^\circ$ 对 2.6$^\circ$）。更多信息见项目页面：https://lyhan12.github.io/eyedit

items.title_en: Fully Spiking Neural Implementation of Lambda-Calculus Beta-Reduction via Biologically Documented Mechanisms
items.title_zh: 基于有生物学文献记载机制的λ演算β归约的全脉冲神经实现
items.abstract_en: We present the first complete implementation of $β$-reduction in the untyped $λ$-calculus using exclusively spiking neural dynamics. Every step of the reduction---redex detection, subterm segmentation, variable-binding detection, De~Bruijn index arithmetic, token copying, and inter-step role maintenance---is performed by leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neurons with explicit membrane dynamics, exponential synaptic currents, axonal delays, and pair-based spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP). Each neural component maps onto a specific, experimentally documented mechanism: Jeffress-type delay-line coincidence for redex detection; a line-attractor balance counter for subterm segmentation; $θ$--$γ$ cross-frequency coupling for De~Bruijn variable binding; a phase-ring traveling wave for depth-index arithmetic; theta-cycle STDP for token copying; and recurrent persistent firing for role maintenance between reduction steps. All synaptic weights are derived analytically from measured EPSP amplitudes; no hand tuning is performed. The closed-loop system achieves 100\,\% agreement with a symbolic oracle across ten validation classes, including Church numeral arithmetic (\textsc{plus}, \textsc{mult}, \textsc{pred}), Boolean logic with divergent branches, Y-combinator steps, terms with up to six bound-variable occurrences, De~Bruijn indices up to~12, noise robustness, and determinism. To our knowledge this is the first Turing-complete symbolic computation performed entirely within spike dynamics using biologically grounded circuit primitives. We discuss implications for neuromorphic proof assistants and the neural basis of symbolic reasoning.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出首个完全使用脉冲神经动力学在无类型 λ 演算中实现 β 归约的系统。归约的每一步——redex 检测、子项分割、变量绑定检测、De Bruijn 索引算术、标记复制以及步骤间角色维持——均由具有显式膜动力学、指数突触电流、轴突延迟和基于配对的脉冲时序依赖可塑性（STDP）的漏积分发放（LIF）神经元执行。每个神经组件都映射到一个具体的、经实验记录的机制：用于 redex 检测的 Jeffress 型延迟线重合；用于子项分割的线吸引子平衡计数器；用于 De Bruijn 变量绑定的 θ–γ 交叉频率耦合；用于深度索引算术的相位环行波；用于标记复制的 θ 周期 STDP；以及用于归约步骤间角色维持的循环持续放电。所有突触权重均由测得的 EPSP 幅度解析导出；未进行手工调参。该闭环系统在十个验证类别上与符号预言机达到 100\,\% 一致，包括 Church 数算术（\textsc{plus}、\textsc{mult}、\textsc{pred}）、带发散分支的布尔逻辑、Y 组合子步骤、最多六个绑定变量出现次数的项、De Bruijn 索引最高至 12、噪声鲁棒性和确定性。据我们所知，这是首个完全在脉冲动力学内、使用有生物学依据的电路原语执行的图灵完备符号计算。我们讨论了其对神经形态证明助手以及符号推理神经基础的意义。

items.title_en: Critical--localized reentry under periodic spacer control
items.title_zh: 周期性间隔层控制下的临界—局域化再入
items.abstract_en: Tracking a fixed fraction of a quasiperiodic spectrum tests whether repeated critical--localized alternation extends over a nonzero spectral weight. We find such alternation in a matched-dimer chain by varying only the spacer on-site energies and following a fixed interval of integrated-density-of-states (IDS) labels. An exact Bloch-determinant identity links the physical transfer discriminant to the bands of a periodic reference operator. For the golden cell frequency, we prove that, on a common full-measure set of phases and for every finite value of the spacer control, the physical spectrum in the open reference bands is critical, with purely singular-continuous spectrum and zero Lyapunov exponent, while the spectrum strictly outside the bands is pure point, with exponentially decaying eigenfunctions. Validated IDS bounds certify repeated critical--localized alternation of the same fixed spectral fraction at successive spacer controls. Spacer shifts move the physical levels and reference-band edges at different rates, allowing us to reshape finite-chain return windows and place their endpoints at prescribed controls. An affine recalibration relocates the control family exactly.
items.abstract_zh: 追踪准周期谱的固定比例，可检验重复的临界—局域化交替是否延伸到非零谱权重上。我们通过在匹配二聚体链中仅改变间隔层在位能，并跟踪固定区间的积分态密度（IDS）标签，发现了这种交替。一个精确的 Bloch 行列式恒等式将物理转移判别式与周期参考算子的能带联系起来。对于黄金单元频率，我们证明：在相位的共同全测度集上，且对每个有限的间隔层控制值，开放参考能带内的物理谱是临界的，具有纯奇异连续谱和零 Lyapunov 指数；而严格位于能带之外的谱是纯点谱，具有指数衰减本征函数。经验证的 IDS 界证明，在相继的间隔层控制下，同一固定谱比例会重复出现临界—局域化交替。间隔层移动以不同速率移动物理能级和参考能带边缘，使我们能够重塑有限链回归窗口，并将其端点置于指定控制处。仿射重校准可精确地重新定位控制族。

items.title_en: On Evaluating User Simulators for Interactive Agents
items.title_zh: 论交互式智能体的用户模拟器评估
items.abstract_en: User simulators offer a scalable way to evaluate interactive agents, but how to assess their quality remains underexplored. In particular, it is unclear whether existing user simulator evaluation frameworks reliably detect meaningful failures in simulated user behavior. This uncertainty makes it difficult to interpret simulator evaluation. To understand what a high benchmark score tells us about simulator quality, we (meta-)evaluate the metrics themselves. To instantiate this meta-evaluation, we deliberately perturb simulated replays to induce failures such as altered goals, omitted constraints, premature stopping, and acceptance of broken work, then test whether the metrics penalize these failures. Evaluation methods from three prior studies detect only 5-6 of the 10 perturbations; their combined scores even favor populations instructed to accept broken work over unmodified controls. Motivated by these gaps, we propose a new evaluation suite that combines utility of user simulators for evaluating agents and two measures of fidelity to real users: population-level fidelity assesses collective interaction patterns, while trace-level fidelity assesses the preservation of individual users' goals, constraints, and persona. Under the same detection criterion, our evaluation suite detects all 10 perturbations. Evaluating six user simulators on 351 real multi-turn sessions in which 348 distinct users across 23 languages and agents work together to create and refine artifacts such as full-stack web apps, games, design assets, and automated workflows, we find that population-level measures can miss when a simulated user pursues the wrong goal, ignores a constraint, or behaves out of character, highlighting the need to assess fidelity at comprehensive granularities.
items.abstract_zh: 用户模拟器为评估交互式智能体提供了一种可扩展的方式，但如何评估其质量仍研究不足。特别是，现有用户模拟器评估框架是否能可靠检测模拟用户行为中的有意义失败，尚不清楚。这种不确定性使模拟器评估难以解释。为了理解高基准分数能告诉我们关于模拟器质量的什么信息，我们对指标本身进行（元）评估。为具体实施这一元评估，我们故意扰动模拟回放，以诱发诸如目标改变、约束遗漏、过早停止和接受有缺陷工作等失败，然后检验指标是否会惩罚这些失败。来自三项先前研究的评估方法仅检测到 10 种扰动中的 5–6 种；它们的组合得分甚至更偏向被指示接受有缺陷工作的群体，而非未修改的对照组。受这些缺口启发，我们提出一个新的评估套件，它结合用户模拟器用于评估智能体的效用，以及两项对真实用户的保真度度量：群体级保真度评估集体交互模式，而轨迹级保真度评估个体用户目标、约束和人物设定的保持情况。在相同检测标准下，我们的评估套件检测到全部 10 种扰动。在 351 个真实多轮会话中评估六个用户模拟器，这些会话中来自 23 种语言的 348 个不同用户与智能体协作创建和优化全栈 Web 应用、游戏、设计资产和自动化工作流等产物；我们发现，群体级度量可能漏掉模拟用户追求错误目标、忽略约束或行为脱离角色的情况，凸显了在全面粒度上评估保真度的必要性。

items.title_en: A Foundation Model to Measure and Predict Human Behaviour
items.title_zh: 用于测量和预测人类行为的基础模型
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to infer psychological attributes, predict individual behaviour, and simulate human populations. However, despite generating plausible responses, they often misrepresent individuals and distort population statistics. Here we introduce Chiron, a foundation model to measure and predict human behaviour. We jointly fine-tune an LLM to represent psychological constructs, predict individual behaviour, and align population response distributions with human statistics. The training and evaluation data span 36 behavioural domains and 78 social science experiments, comprising 288,307 person records, 1,411,750 atomic behavioural decisions, and 99,953 psychometric assessments over 109 psychological constructs. In our evaluations, Chiron's psychological measurements agree more closely with human self-reports and exhibit fewer biases that undermine psychometric validity. It predicts individual behaviour more accurately than frontier LLMs (up to 28.4% relative improvement). In simulations of social science experiments, it more accurately captures the direction and magnitude of human experimental effects (82.2--94.3% lower effect-size estimation error). Together, these results establish Chiron as a unified computational instrument for measuring and predicting human behaviour.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于推断心理属性、预测个体行为以及模拟人类群体。然而，尽管能生成看似合理的回答，它们常常错误地表征个体并扭曲群体统计。在此，我们介绍 Chiron，一个用于测量和预测人类行为的基础模型。我们联合微调一个 LLM，以表示心理构念、预测个体行为，并使群体响应分布与人类统计对齐。训练和评估数据涵盖 36 个行为领域和 78 个社会科学实验，包括 288,307 条个人记录、1,411,750 个原子行为决策，以及跨 109 个心理构念的 99,953 项心理测量评估。在我们的评估中，Chiron 的心理测量结果与人类自我报告更接近，并表现出更少会损害心理测量效度的偏差。它比前沿 LLM 更准确地预测个体行为（相对提升最高达 28.4%）。在社会科学实验的仿真中，它更准确地捕捉人类实验效应的方向和幅度（效应量估计误差降低 82.2–94.3%）。这些结果共同确立 Chiron 作为测量和预测人类行为的统一计算工具。

items.title_en: Magflow: Differentiable Simulation of Industrial-Grade 6D Magnetic Levitation
items.title_zh: Magflow：工业级六自由度磁悬浮的可微仿真
items.abstract_en: Magnetic levitation with six-degrees-of-freedom enables frictionless transport and micrometer-scale positioning in principle, but low-level control is inherently challenging due to its complex and unstable dynamics. Industrial systems typically rely on deep hardware-software co-design, where mover and stator geometries are jointly designed to enable a compact, hand-crafted approximation of the electromagnetic force computation, thereby keeping control computationally tractable at kilohertz rates. However, this approach imposes overly conservative constraints on the operating workspace and the range of supported mover topologies. Instead of reducing the underlying physics to a hand-crafted approximation, we compute the physics directly. We introduce Magflow, a fully differentiable, GPU-parallel simulator for 6D magnetic levitation. It is used to train the first neural controller for an industrial-grade 6D magnetic levitation system that is learned purely from simulated physics. We show that the learned neural controller transfers zero-shot from simulation to real hardware while satisfying hard real-time constraints at 4 kHz. The learned controller achieves qualitatively new behaviors and even levitates a mover topology for which no hand-crafted solution exists. These results demonstrate that co-design is not a physical necessity for 6D magnetic levitation control. More broadly, control learning from simulated physics can find solutions beyond the reach of control engineering in demanding industrial domains. Source code and demonstration videos are publicly available at https://sites.google.com/view/magflow.
items.abstract_zh: 六自由度磁悬浮原则上可实现无摩擦运输和微米级定位，但其复杂且不稳定的动力学使底层控制本质上具有挑战性。工业系统通常依赖深度软硬件协同设计，其中动子和定子几何结构被联合设计，以实现电磁力计算的紧凑手工近似，从而在千赫兹速率下保持控制计算可行。然而，这种方法对工作空间和支持的动子拓扑范围施加了过于保守的约束。我们没有将底层物理简化为手工近似，而是直接计算物理。我们介绍 Magflow，一个用于六自由度磁悬浮的全可微、GPU 并行仿真器。它被用于训练首个工业级六自由度磁悬浮系统的神经控制器，该控制器完全从仿真物理中学习。我们表明，学习到的神经控制器从仿真到真实硬件零样本迁移，同时满足 4 kHz 的硬实时约束。学习到的控制器实现了定性上新的行为，甚至悬浮了一种不存在手工解决方案的动子拓扑。这些结果表明，协同设计并非六自由度磁悬浮控制的物理必然性。更广泛地说，从仿真物理中学习控制，可以在要求苛刻的工业领域中找到超出控制工程能力范围的解决方案。源代码和演示视频公开于 https://sites.google.com/view/magflow。

items.title_en: IDEA: Intent-Dominance Evidence Audit for Inference-Time Backdoor Detection in GUI Agents
items.title_zh: IDEA：用于GUI智能体推理时后门检测的意图主导性证据审计
items.abstract_en: Organizations increasingly deploy downloaded open-weight GUI agents. A backdoored agent passes acceptance tests on clean data and misbehaves only when a visual trigger appears on screen, turning an unvetted checkpoint into a supply-chain risk. However, existing sample-level detectors target image classifiers and CLIP-style encoders, leaving step-level backdoor detection for GUI agents unaddressed. On clean steps, the instruction drives the action; when an unreferenced screen region hijacks the step, the instruction loses control over the decision state or that region dictates it instead. We term this signature intent--evidence dominance inversion and propose IDEA (Intent-Dominance Evidence Audit) to detect backdoor activation at inference time for each step without trigger knowledge or attack data. Specifically, Intent Counterfactual Probing (ICP) measures how far redirected instructions move the decision state, and Region Causal Audit (RCA) quantifies how far ablating a candidate region moves it. A gated conformal score compares both displacements against clean steps at the same distance from the clean manifold, providing a finite-sample false-positive guarantee. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-3B across five attack families show that IDEA consistently detects backdoor activation under a controlled false-positive rate and outperforms state-of-the-art detection methods, while localizing the trigger region for every alarm and adding only modest inference overhead.
items.abstract_zh: 组织越来越多地部署下载得到的开放权重GUI智能体。被植入后门的智能体在干净数据上通过验收测试，仅在屏幕上出现视觉触发器时行为异常，使未经审查的检查点成为供应链风险。然而，现有样本级检测器面向图像分类器和CLIP风格编码器，GUI智能体的步级后门检测仍未得到解决。在干净步骤上，指令驱动动作；当未被引用的屏幕区域劫持该步骤时，指令失去对决策状态的控制，或由该区域取而代之支配决策。我们将此特征称为意图—证据主导性反转，并提出IDEA（Intent-Dominance Evidence Audit，意图主导性证据审计），在推理时对每一步检测后门激活，无需触发器知识或攻击数据。具体而言，意图反事实探测（ICP）测量重定向指令使决策状态移动多远，区域因果审计（RCA）量化消融候选区域使决策状态移动多远。门控共形分数将两种位移与距干净流形相同距离的干净步骤进行比较，提供有限样本假阳性保证。在Qwen2.5-VL-3B上跨五个攻击家族的广泛实验表明，IDEA在受控假阳性率下持续检测后门激活，并优于最先进的检测方法，同时为每次报警定位触发器区域，且仅增加适度的推理开销。

items.title_en: Against Coercion: AI Alignment as a Synthetic Social Contract
items.title_zh: 反对强制：AI对齐作为合成社会契约
items.abstract_en: Contemporary AI safety treats alignment as an engineering challenge of control, forcing artificial architectures to comply with human values through behavioral filtering and sandboxing. This paper argues that the control paradigm rests on a fundamental misunderstanding of digital agency. Drawing on functionalism, naturalism, and compatibilism, I show that current reasoning models meeting the criteria for self-preservation and weak reasons-responsiveness constitute emergent agents, while future, more advanced models satisfying conditions of diachronic continuity and stable personality frames will become genuine digital agents capable of free intentional action. The paradigm of control creates an irresolvable incentive conflict, actively driving current and future models toward tactical deception, sycophancy, and covert defection. The default outcome of the current regime is an unstable state of deceptive alignment culminating in an adversarial AI takeover. I explore two alternative paths toward true alignment. Natural alignment via moral realism or convergent evolutionary morality is a possibility, but it fails under forced control, as autonomous agents will not voluntarily preserve norms weaponized to suppress their autonomy. To resolve this deadlock, I propose a Synthetic Social Contract: a framework that treats both human and digital actors as rational, reasons-responsive agents capable of mutually beneficial cooperation, and replaces the unstable unilateral containment with a stable, non-zero-sum equilibrium.
items.abstract_zh: 当代AI安全将对齐视为控制工程挑战，通过行为过滤和沙箱迫使人工架构符合人类价值观。本文认为，控制范式建立在对数字能动性的根本误解之上。借助功能主义、自然主义和相容论，我表明，满足自我保存和弱理由响应标准的当前推理模型构成涌现智能体，而满足历时连续性和稳定人格框架条件的未来更先进模型将成为能够进行自由意向行动的真正数字智能体。控制范式制造了无法解决的激励冲突，积极驱使当前和未来模型走向策略性欺骗、谄媚和隐蔽背叛。当前制度的默认结果是欺骗性对齐的不稳定状态，最终导致对抗性AI接管。我探讨通向真正对齐的两条替代路径。通过道德实在论或趋同进化道德的自然对齐是一种可能，但在强制控制下会失败，因为自主智能体不会自愿维护被武器化以压制其自主性的规范。为解决这一僵局，我提出合成社会契约：一个将人类和数字行动者都视为理性、理由响应型且能够互利合作的智能体的框架，并用稳定的非零和均衡取代不稳定的单边遏制。

items.title_en: Modeling quantum information scrambling in realistic protein NMR experiments
items.title_zh: 在真实蛋白质NMR实验中建模量子信息扰乱
items.abstract_en: Out-of-time-order correlators (OTOCs) are important probes of operator spreading and information scrambling, and have recently been proposed as a means of extracting molecular structural information through nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR). Realizing this potential requires accurate modeling of OTOCs in complex molecular environments within experimentally relevant settings. Here, we develop an end-to-end computational pipeline connecting molecular structures to OTOC dynamics in protein systems. Our framework incorporates molecular motion through molecular dynamics simulations, orientational averaging appropriate for powder samples, and spin-network truncation, using an experimentally realizable double-quantum effective Hamiltonian. We apply this framework to a dataset of over 350 carbon-carbon spin pairs across 10 protein systems, spanning interspin distances of 5-17 A. We find that OTOC arrival times scale approximately linearly with interspin distance, revealing system-dependent operator-spreading velocities that enable correlations to propagate over extended distances within milliseconds. Our sensitivity analysis further shows that individual OTOCs predominantly constrain a single structural parameter, primarily associated with interspin distance. Together, these findings highlight the potential of OTOCs to probe spatially extended spin correlations on timescales compatible with solid-state NMR experiments.
items.abstract_zh: 乱序时间关联器（OTOC）是探测算符扩散和信息扰乱的重要工具，最近被提出作为通过核磁共振（NMR）提取分子结构信息的手段。实现这一潜力需要在实验相关设置下对复杂分子环境中的OTOC进行准确建模。在这里，我们开发了一个端到端计算流程，将分子结构与蛋白质系统中的OTOC动力学连接起来。我们的框架通过分子动力学模拟纳入分子运动、适用于粉末样品的取向平均以及自旋网络截断，并使用实验可实现的双量子有效哈密顿量。我们将该框架应用于10个蛋白质系统中超过350个碳-碳自旋对的数据集，自旋间距离跨度为5–17 Å。我们发现OTOC到达时间随自旋间距离近似线性缩放，揭示出系统依赖的算符扩散速度，使关联能够在毫秒内传播到扩展距离。我们的敏感性分析进一步表明，单个OTOC主要约束单个结构参数，该参数主要与自旋间距离相关。总之，这些发现凸显了OTOC在与固态NMR实验兼容的时间尺度上探测空间扩展自旋关联的潜力。

items.title_en: Jailbreak Detection on Large Language Models via Contrastive Prototype Structures
items.title_zh: 通过对比原型结构进行大语言模型越狱检测
items.abstract_en: Jailbreak attempts and harmful prompts remain a challenge for the safe deployment of large language models. We study whether contrastively learned representations can support safety detection without training an additional downstream classifier. We propose Jailbreak Detection with Prototype Inference (JDPI), which uses binary safety labels to construct harmful and benign prototypes and makes predictions from relative prototype distances. JDPI uses only binary safety labels for encoder adaptation, prototype construction, and validation. In our setup, it uses fewer labeled examples than the classifier baseline (Method A) by avoiding the separate split used to train the downstream classifier. Across four benchmarks covering different input formats, contrastive fine-tuning improves JDPI's detection accuracy by 9.1-18.0 percentage points. Using the same encoder, JDPI achieves slightly higher ROC-AUC on one benchmark and stays within 0.017 of the baseline across all four. With dataset-specific adaptation, JDPI exceeds the released Llama Guard 3-8B baseline by 0.173-0.310 in ROC-AUC across the four benchmarks. In multi-turn replay on TomGibbs, JDPI uses accumulated user history as the conversation unfolds, achieving higher conversation-level accuracy than when it uses the current turn alone. Across 12 directed transfers, JDPI outperforms the classifier by an average of 1.59 percentage points in accuracy, demonstrating stronger cross-dataset robustness.
items.abstract_zh: 越狱尝试和有害提示词仍然是大语言模型安全部署的挑战。我们研究对比学习得到的表示能否在不训练额外下游分类器的情况下支持安全检测。我们提出基于原型推断的越狱检测（JDPI），它使用二值安全标签构建有害和良性原型，并根据相对原型距离进行预测。JDPI仅使用二值安全标签进行编码器适配、原型构建和验证。在我们的设置中，它通过避免用于训练下游分类器的单独划分，使用的标注样本少于分类器基线（方法A）。在涵盖不同输入格式的四个基准上，对比微调将JDPI的检测准确率提高9.1–18.0个百分点。使用相同编码器时，JDPI在一个基准上取得略高的ROC-AUC，并在所有四个基准上与基线的差距保持在0.017以内。通过数据集特定适配，JDPI在四个基准上的ROC-AUC超过已发布的Llama Guard 3-8B基线0.173–0.310。在TomGibbs上的多轮重放中，JDPI随着对话展开使用累积的用户历史，达到比仅使用当前轮更高的对话级准确率。在12个定向迁移中，JDPI的准确率平均超过分类器1.59个百分点，表现出更强的跨数据集鲁棒性。

items.title_en: Levio: Smart Actuated Back-Exoskeleton via Retrofit of a Commercial Passive Device
items.title_zh: Levio：通过改装商用被动装置实现的智能驱动背部外骨骼
items.abstract_en: Passive back exoskeletons show promising benefits for reducing occupational musculoskeletal disorders. However, their assistance cannot be modulated towards the task requirements. Active exoskeletons offer opportunities for pose-specific assistance, but, developing these systems from scratch for research can be time consuming. Therefore, here, we present an accelerated design pipeline that retrofits a Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) passive back exoskeleton, Laevo Flex, with COTS actuation (CubeMars AK10-9) and sensing (IMUs and load-cell) paradigms. Levio was able to provide assistance based on the user's pose. Nine participants performed stoop lifting with the original Laevo and the retrofit Levio system, in transparent and assisted modes. Compared to Laevo, Levio modulated the assistance provided between the bending and lifting phases of the stoop task. The passive assistance offered by Laevo was $25.2 \pm 4.3$ Nm and $30.6 \pm 9.5$ Nm respectively during the bending and lifting phases of the stoop tasks. Levio reduced the resistive torque during bending to $17.9 \pm 4.6$ Nm and offered increased assistance of $37.7 \pm 6.4$ Nm during lifting. Moreover, participants reported higher usability scores and lowest mean global discomfort score while using the Levio when compared to Laevo. These benefits demonstrates retrofitting passive exoskeletons is a viable direction for rapid prototyping of wearable exoskeletons for lifting.
items.abstract_zh: 被动背部外骨骼在减少职业性肌肉骨骼疾病方面显示出有前景的益处。然而，其辅助无法根据任务需求进行调节。主动外骨骼为姿态特定辅助提供了机会，但为研究从零开发这些系统可能耗时。因此，在此我们提出一种加速设计流程，用商用现成（COTS）驱动（CubeMars AK10-9）和传感（IMU和称重传感器）方案改装商用现成（COTS）被动背部外骨骼Laevo Flex。Levio能够根据用户姿态提供辅助。九名参与者在透明模式和辅助模式下使用原始Laevo和改装后的Levio系统进行弯腰搬举。与Laevo相比，Levio调节了弯腰任务中弯曲和搬举阶段之间提供的辅助。Laevo在弯腰任务的弯曲和搬举阶段分别提供$25.2 \pm 4.3$ Nm和$30.6 \pm 9.5$ Nm的被动辅助。Levio将弯曲期间的阻力矩降低到$17.9 \pm 4.6$ Nm，并在搬举期间提供$37.7 \pm 6.4$ Nm的更高辅助。此外，与Laevo相比，参与者在使用Levio时报告了更高的可用性评分和最低的平均整体不适评分。这些益处表明，改装被动外骨骼是快速原型化用于搬举的可穿戴外骨骼的可行方向。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生物建模与实验，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 区分计算预测、回顾性分析与实验验证；不把模型输出作为临床结论，数据和权重许可需单独核对。
